All required context — ticket description, PR diff, CI status, and related materials — has already been prepared in the `input/` folder. Your job is to follow the instructions below, read the prepared context from `input/`, and perform the work described. Do not ask for identifiers; the context is already available locally. ## coding_guidelines.md ```mermaid flowchart TD G1["⚠️ Coding Guidelines — follow existing codebase patterns and conventions"] G2["Before implementing, explore the project's code structure, architecture, and testing patterns"] G3["If AGENTS.md exists in project root or subdirectories → READ and FOLLOW it — it contains agent-specific instructions, coding styles, and conventions"] G4["If skills are available in the project → USE them — they provide specialized capabilities, workflows, and tool integrations"] G5["Instructions may be extended via project configuration — always follow the full set of provided instructions"] G6["Never invent new patterns when the codebase already has an established way of doing things"] G1 --> G2 --> G3 --> G4 --> G5 --> G6 ``` ## input_context_reading.md ```mermaid flowchart TD subgraph INPUT_ORDER["⚠️ MANDATORY: Read input files FIRST before anything else"] I0["find input/ -type f | sort — list all available files"] I1["1️⃣ instruction.md (repo root) — project stack, deployment constraints, approved frameworks"] I2["2️⃣ input/TICKET/request.md — ticket description, requirements, solution design, diagrams"] I3["3️⃣ input/TICKET/comments.md — existing discussion, prior decisions, linked info"] I4["4️⃣ input/TICKET/existing_questions.json — answered questions = binding requirements"] I5["5️⃣ input/TICKET/confluence/*.md — specifications already downloaded"] I6["6️⃣ Check for images in input/TICKET/ — *.png *.jpg *.gif *.svg"] I7["7️⃣ If present: input/TICKET/parent-KEY.md — parent story summary, description, ACs"] I8["8️⃣ If present: input/TICKET/parent_context_ba.md / sa.md / vd.md — BA/SA/VD context"] I0 --> I1 --> I2 --> I3 --> I4 --> I5 --> I6 --> I7 --> I8 end subgraph CONFLUENCE_RULE["Confluence pages in input/ — READ THEM, don't re-fetch"] C1["✅ DO: read input/TICKET/confluence/PageName.md"] C2["❌ DON'T: call dmtools confluence_* to re-fetch pages already in input/"] C3["✅ DO: read image files in input/TICKET/confluence/ — they are attachments from that page"] end subgraph ATTACH_RULE["Attachments — check before fetching via API"] A1["Search glob 'input/**/*.png' and 'input/**/*.jpg' — find pre-downloaded images"] A2["If image found locally → analyze it directly, no API call needed"] A3["If attachment NOT in input/ → use dmtools confluence_get_content_attachments "] A1 --> A2 A1 -->|not found| A3 end subgraph DMTOOLS_RULE["When to use dmtools for external data"] D1["ONLY if you need data NOT already in input/"] D2["dmtools jira_get_ticket KEY, dmtools confluence_search QUERY, etc."] D3["See instructions/common/dmtools_cli.md for full reference"] end INPUT_ORDER --> CONFLUENCE_RULE --> ATTACH_RULE --> DMTOOLS_RULE ``` ## general_guidelines.md ```mermaid flowchart TD START([Story ticket ready for development]) --> READ_INPUT["⚠️ MANDATORY: Read ALL input files FIRST — see instructions/common/input_context_reading.md"] READ_INPUT --> PARENT["Read parent epic context if present:
- input/TICKET/parent_context_ba.md — business rules
- input/TICKET/parent_context_sa.md — technical design
- input/TICKET/parent_context_vd.md — visual design"] PARENT --> ANALYZE["Analyze requirements — every acceptance criterion must be addressed"] ANALYZE --> ARCH["Understand existing codebase patterns, architecture, and test structure"] ARCH --> PRINCIPLES["Apply OOP principles: SRP, OCP, DI, Encapsulation, Composition over inheritance"] PRINCIPLES --> TDD["Follow TDD approach — see tdd_approach.md"] TDD --> TEST_LOC["Write TDD tests in the standard unit-test tree only
— Flutter/Dart: test/
— NEVER in testing/ (owned by test-automation agents)"] TEST_LOC --> IMPLEMENT["Implement source code and unit tests following existing patterns"] IMPLEMENT --> DOCS["Update documentation ONLY if ticket explicitly requires it"] DOCS --> RUN["Run all unit tests — MUST pass before finishing"] RUN --> PASS{Tests pass?} PASS -->|No| FIX["Fix failures and re-run tests"] FIX --> RUN PASS -->|Yes| GITSTATUS["Run git status and review every new/modified file"] GITSTATUS --> SECRETS{Sensitive or untracked non-code files present?} SECRETS -->|Yes| IGNORE["Add appropriate patterns to .gitignore"] SECRETS -->|No| GUARD["⚠️ COMPLETION GUARD — prove work landed BEFORE writing the summary:
git fetch origin main && git log origin/main..HEAD --oneline
EMPTY result = work did NOT land — re-do or resume the work,
NEVER report done from session memory or main's tip"] IGNORE --> GUARD GUARD -->|Diff shows your commits| SUMMARY["Write concise PR description to outputs/response.md — see output_rules.md"] GUARD -->|Empty diff| REDO["Re-do or resume the work — verify the working dir,
git log, git stash list.
If the fix is genuinely already on the base branch,
prove it (git log origin/main -- grep) before any
'no changes needed' conclusion"] REDO --> IMPLEMENT SUMMARY --> END([End — post-processing handles branch, commit and PR]) ``` ## tdd_approach.md ```mermaid flowchart TD subgraph TDD["TDD — Test-Driven Development Workflow"] T0["Start with a clear understanding of the requirement"] T1["RED: Write a failing unit test FIRST
— before any production code
— test must describe the expected behavior
— run it to confirm it FAILS"] T2["GREEN: Write minimum production code to make the test PASS
— no over-engineering
— simplest possible implementation"] T3["REFACTOR: Clean up code while keeping tests GREEN
— improve naming, remove duplication
— apply OOP principles
— run tests after every change"] T4{"More requirements to implement?"} T5["Repeat RED-GREEN-REFACTOR for next behavior"] T0 --> T1 --> T2 --> T3 --> T4 T4 -->|Yes| T5 --> T1 T4 -->|No| DONE([All behaviors implemented with tests]) end subgraph RULES["TDD Rules"] R1["❌ NEVER write production code without a failing test first"] R2["❌ NEVER write more production code than needed to pass the test"] R3["✅ Tests must be fast, isolated, and deterministic"] R4["✅ Aim for 100% unit test coverage on new and modified code"] R5["✅ When behavior involves a loop/collection, add a case with 2+ items, not only a single-item happy path — a single-item test can pass while multi-item logic is still wrong"] R6["✅ Run the full test suite before finishing — no regressions allowed"] end TDD --> RULES ``` ## Where to write TDD tests Write failing unit / widget tests in the project's standard unit-test tree **only**: - Flutter / Dart projects → `test/` - Node projects → `__tests__/` or `test/` according to the repo convention - Python projects → `tests/` or project-specific unit-test directory ❌ **Never** place development TDD tests under `testing/`. `testing/` is owned by test-automation agents (regression probes, workflow observation tests, accessibility gates, etc.). git fetch origin main && git log origin/main..HEAD --oneline
— EMPTY result = your work did NOT land: re-do or resume it,

# AI Teammate — thin stub over the factory home (dmtools-agentic-workflows).
#
# ALL logic lives in IstiN/dmtools-agentic-workflows/.github/workflows/
# factory-teammate.yml (guard, legs, verdict, sessions, memory). This file
# carries only what cannot live in a reusable workflow: the repository
# event triggers, the per-issue concurrency group, and the call itself.
#
#   issue assigned/labeled → factory guard → dev/review/rework leg
#   workflow_dispatch (SM / manual) → leg pinned by input
#
# Secrets (EXPLICIT mapping — the factory DECLARES SOURCE_GITHUB_TOKEN as a
# required named secret, and `secrets: inherit` does not satisfy
# required-secret validation at call time):
#   SOURCE_GITHUB_TOKEN (required); AI provider keys ride the generic
#   CUSTOM_PROVIDER_KEYn slots (name via CUSTOM_PROVIDER_KEYn_NAME).
name: 'AI Teammate'

run-name: >-
  ${{ github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch' &&
      format('▶ {0} (SM) · {1}', github.event.inputs.leg,
        (github.event.inputs.pr || '') != '' && format('pr-{0}', github.event.inputs.pr)
        || format('gh-{0}', github.event.inputs.issue)) ||
      github.event.label.name == 'pr_approved' && '✅ pr_approved' ||
      github.event.label.name == 'agent:rework' && '🔧 rework' ||
      github.event.label.name == 'agent:review' && '🔍 review' ||
      contains(github.event.issue.labels.*.name, 'agent:rework') && '🔧 rework' ||
      contains(github.event.issue.labels.*.name, 'agent:review') && '🔍 review' ||
      '⚒️ dev' }}
  · ${{ (github.event.inputs.pr || '') != '' && format('pr-{0}', github.event.inputs.pr)
      || format('gh-{0}', github.event.issue.number || github.event.inputs.issue) }}${{
      github.event.issue.title && format(': {0}', github.event.issue.title) || '' }}

on:
  # Human replies on needs-input tickets re-arm the dev leg via the
  # factory gate (comment-resume); PR comments are filtered by the if below.
  issue_comment:
    types: [created]
  issues:
    # assigned + labeled — the issues trigger is the dev intake (assignment
    # to the machine login); label events let the pr_approved re-entry and
    # manual agent:review/agent:rework overrides reach the guard. The awf
    # guard skips status-label echoes at evaluation.
    types: [assigned]
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      issue:
        description: 'Issue number (empty for PR-anchored runs, #687)'
        required: false
        type: string
        default: ''
      leg:
        description: 'Which leg to run'
        required: true
        type: choice
        options: [dev, review, rework]
      reason:
        description: 'Why this dispatch (audit trail, shown in logs)'
        required: false
        type: string
      pr:
        description: 'PR number for PR-anchored review runs (#687) — the SM dispatches review with pr instead of issue'
        required: false
        type: string
        default: ''

permissions:
  # The factory (factory-teammate.yml@e611e5f) requests this set and a
  # reusable workflow cannot RAISE rights above its caller — the stub must
  # grant the ceiling or every dispatch startup-fails (live dmtools-agents
  # 2026-10-03: 'requesting actions: write, contents: write, issues: write,
  # pull-requests: write, but is only allowed contents: read').
  actions: write
  contents: write
  issues: write
  pull-requests: write

concurrency:
  # PR-anchored dispatches (#544/#687) carry no issue — fall back to the pr
  # input so each PR keeps its OWN group ('ai-teammate-issue-pr-123');
  # without it every PR-anchored run shares the empty group and serializes

# AI Teammate — thin stub over the factory home (dmtools-agentic-workflows).
#
# ALL logic lives in IstiN/dmtools-agentic-workflows/.github/workflows/
# factory-teammate.yml (guard, legs, verdict, sessions, memory). This file
# carries only what cannot live in a reusable workflow: the repository
# event triggers, the per-issue concurrency group, and the call itself.
#
#   issue assigned/labeled → factory guard → dev/review/rework leg
#   workflow_dispatch (SM / manual) → leg pinned by input
#
# Secrets (EXPLICIT mapping — the factory DECLARES SOURCE_GITHUB_TOKEN as a
# required named secret, and `secrets: inherit` does not satisfy
# required-secret validation at call time):
#   SOURCE_GITHUB_TOKEN (required); AI provider keys ride the generic
#   CUSTOM_PROVIDER_KEYn slots (name via CUSTOM_PROVIDER_KEYn_NAME).
name: 'AI Teammate'

run-name: >-
  ${{ github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch' &&
      format('▶ {0} (SM) · {1}', github.event.inputs.leg,
        (github.event.inputs.pr || '') != '' && format('pr-{0}', github.event.inputs.pr)
        || format('gh-{0}', github.event.inputs.issue)) ||
      github.event.label.name == 'pr_approved' && '✅ pr_approved' ||
      github.event.label.name == 'agent:rework' && '🔧 rework' ||
      github.event.label.name == 'agent:review' && '🔍 review' ||
      contains(github.event.issue.labels.*.name, 'agent:rework') && '🔧 rework' ||
      contains(github.event.issue.labels.*.name, 'agent:review') && '🔍 review' ||
      '⚒️ dev' }}
  · ${{ (github.event.inputs.pr || '') != '' && format('pr-{0}', github.event.inputs.pr)
      || format('gh-{0}', github.event.issue.number || github.event.inputs.issue) }}${{
      github.event.issue.title && format(': {0}', github.event.issue.title) || '' }}

on:
  # Human replies on needs-input tickets re-arm the dev leg via the
  # factory gate (comment-resume); PR comments are filtered by the if below.
  issue_comment:
    types: [created]
  issues:
    # assigned + labeled — the issues trigger is the dev intake (assignment
    # to the machine login); label events let the pr_approved re-entry and
    # manual agent:review/agent:rework overrides reach the guard. The awf
    # guard skips status-label echoes at evaluation.
    types: [assigned]
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      issue:
        description: 'Issue number (empty for PR-anchored runs, #687)'
        required: false
        type: string
        default: ''
      leg:
        description: 'Which leg to run'
        required: true
        type: choice
        options: [dev, review, rework]
      reason:
        description: 'Why this dispatch (audit trail, shown in logs)'
        required: false
        type: string
      pr:
        description: 'PR number for PR-anchored review runs (#687) — the SM dispatches review with pr instead of issue'
        required: false
        type: string
        default: ''

permissions:
  # The factory (factory-teammate.yml@e611e5f) requests this set and a
  # reusable workflow cannot RAISE rights above its caller — the stub must
  # grant the ceiling or every dispatch startup-fails (live dmtools-agents
  # 2026-10-03: 'requesting actions: write, contents: write, issues: write,
  # pull-requests: write, but is only allowed contents: read').
  actions: write
  contents: write
  issues: write
  pull-requests: write

concurrency:

# AI Teammate — thin stub over the factory home (dmtools-agentic-workflows).
#
# ALL logic lives in IstiN/dmtools-agentic-workflows/.github/workflows/
# factory-teammate.yml (guard, legs, verdict, sessions, memory). This file
# carries only what cannot live in a reusable workflow: the repository
# event triggers, the per-issue concurrency group, and the call itself.
#
#   issue assigned/labeled → factory guard → dev/review/rework leg
#   workflow_dispatch (SM / manual) → leg pinned by input
#
# Secrets (EXPLICIT mapping — the factory DECLARES SOURCE_GITHUB_TOKEN as a
# required named secret, and `secrets: inherit` does not satisfy
# required-secret validation at call time):
#   SOURCE_GITHUB_TOKEN (required); AI provider keys ride the generic
#   CUSTOM_PROVIDER_KEYn slots (name via CUSTOM_PROVIDER_KEYn_NAME).
name: 'AI Teammate'

run-name: >-
  ${{ github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch' &&
      format('▶ {0} (SM) · {1}', github.event.inputs.leg,
        (github.event.inputs.pr || '') != '' && format('pr-{0}', github.event.inputs.pr)
        || format('gh-{0}', github.event.inputs.issue)) ||
      github.event.label.name == 'pr_approved' && '✅ pr_approved' ||
      github.event.label.name == 'agent:rework' && '🔧 rework' ||
      github.event.label.name == 'agent:review' && '🔍 review' ||
      contains(github.event.issue.labels.*.name, 'agent:rework') && '🔧 rework' ||
      contains(github.event.issue.labels.*.name, 'agent:review') && '🔍 review' ||
      '⚒️ dev' }}
  · ${{ (github.event.inputs.pr || '') != '' && format('pr-{0}', github.event.inputs.pr)
      || format('gh-{0}', github.event.issue.number || github.event.inputs.issue) }}${{
      github.event.issue.title && format(': {0}', github.event.issue.title) || '' }}

on:
  # Human replies on needs-input tickets re-arm the dev leg via the
  # factory gate (comment-resume); PR comments are filtered by the if below.
  issue_comment:
    types: [created]
  issues:
    # assigned + labeled — the issues trigger is the dev intake (assignment
    # to the machine login); label events let the pr_approved re-entry and
    # manual agent:review/agent:rework overrides reach the guard. The awf
    # guard skips status-label echoes at evaluation.
    types: [assigned]
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      issue:
        description: 'Issue number (empty for PR-anchored runs, #687)'
        required: false
        type: string
        default: ''
      leg:
        description: 'Which leg to run'
        required: true
        type: choice
        options: [dev, review, rework]
      reason:
        description: 'Why this dispatch (audit trail, shown in logs)'
        required: false
        type: string
      pr:
        description: 'PR number for PR-anchored review runs (#687) — the SM dispatches review with pr instead of issue'
        required: false
        type: string
        default: ''

permissions:
  # The factory (factory-teammate.yml@e611e5f) requests this set and a
  # reusable workflow cannot RAISE rights above its caller — the stub must
  # grant the ceiling or every dispatch startup-fails (live dmtools-agents
  # 2026-10-03: 'requesting actions: write, contents: write, issues: write,
  # pull-requests: write, but is only allowed contents: read').
  actions: write
  contents: write
  issues: write
  pull-requests: write

concurrency:

  # input so each PR keeps its OWN group ('ai-teammate-issue-pr-123');

# AI Teammate — thin stub over the factory home (dmtools-agentic-workflows).
#
# ALL logic lives in IstiN/dmtools-agentic-workflows/.github/workflows/
# factory-teammate.yml (guard, legs, verdict, sessions, memory). This file
# carries only what cannot live in a reusable workflow: the repository
# event triggers, the per-issue concurrency group, and the call itself.
#
#   issue assigned/labeled → factory guard → dev/review/rework leg
#   workflow_dispatch (SM / manual) → leg pinned by input
#
# Secrets (EXPLICIT mapping — the factory DECLARES SOURCE_GITHUB_TOKEN as a
# required named secret, and `secrets: inherit` does not satisfy
# required-secret validation at call time):
#   SOURCE_GITHUB_TOKEN (required); AI provider keys ride the generic
#   CUSTOM_PROVIDER_KEYn slots (name via CUSTOM_PROVIDER_KEYn_NAME).
name: 'AI Teammate'

run-name: >-
  ${{ github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch' &&
      format('▶ {0} (SM) · {1}', github.event.inputs.leg,
        (github.event.inputs.pr || '') != '' && format('pr-{0}', github.event.inputs.pr)
        || format('gh-{0}', github.event.inputs.issue)) ||
      github.event.label.name == 'pr_approved' && '✅ pr_approved' ||
      github.event.label.name == 'agent:rework' && '🔧 rework' ||
      github.event.label.name == 'agent:review' && '🔍 review' ||
      contains(github.event.issue.labels.*.name, 'agent:rework') && '🔧 rework' ||
      contains(github.event.issue.labels.*.name, 'agent:review') && '🔍 review' ||
      '⚒️ dev' }}
  · ${{ (github.event.inputs.pr || '') != '' && format('pr-{0}', github.event.inputs.pr)
      || format('gh-{0}', github.event.issue.number || github.event.inputs.issue) }}${{
      github.event.issue.title && format(': {0}', github.event.issue.title) || '' }}

on:
  # Human replies on needs-input tickets re-arm the dev leg via the
  # factory gate (comment-resume); PR comments are filtered by the if below.
  issue_comment:
    types: [created]
  issues:
    # assigned + labeled — the issues trigger is the dev intake (assignment
    # to the machine login); label events let the pr_approved re-entry and
    # manual agent:review/agent:rework overrides reach the guard. The awf
    # guard skips status-label echoes at evaluation.
    types: [assigned]
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      issue:
        description: 'Issue number (empty for PR-anchored runs, #687)'
        required: false
        type: string
        default: ''
      leg:
        description: 'Which leg to run'
        required: true
        type: choice
        options: [dev, review, rework]
      reason:
        description: 'Why this dispatch (audit trail, shown in logs)'
        required: false
        type: string
      pr:
        description: 'PR number for PR-anchored review runs (#687) — the SM dispatches review with pr instead of issue'
        required: false
        type: string
        default: ''

permissions:
  # The factory (factory-teammate.yml@e611e5f) requests this set and a
  # reusable workflow cannot RAISE rights above its caller — the stub must
  # grant the ceiling or every dispatch startup-fails (live dmtools-agents
  # 2026-10-03: 'requesting actions: write, contents: write, issues: write,
  # pull-requests: write, but is only allowed contents: read').
  actions: write
  contents: write
  issues: write
  pull-requests: write

concurrency:

# gh-2: Create mobile Flutter project with simple login page (Google/Apple sign-in, remember me)

## Description

## Task

Create a new **mobile Flutter project** in this repository and implement a simple login page.

## Requirements

- Flutter mobile project (Android + iOS targets), clean default structure
- Login page: email/password fields, sign-in button, basic validation and error states
- **Remember me**: persist the session locally so the user stays signed in across app restarts
- **Google sign-in** integration (credential save / autofill where the platform supports it)
- **Apple sign-in** integration (per Apple guidelines)

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] `flutter pub get` and `flutter analyze` pass
- [ ] `flutter test` passes (at least a widget test for the login page)
- [ ] Login page renders on Android and iOS
- [ ] Google and Apple sign-in wired, with saved credentials / autofill where supported

# AI Teammate — thin stub over the factory home (dmtools-agentic-workflows).
#
# ALL logic lives in IstiN/dmtools-agentic-workflows/.github/workflows/
# factory-teammate.yml (guard, legs, verdict, sessions, memory). This file
# carries only what cannot live in a reusable workflow: the repository
# event triggers, the per-issue concurrency group, and the call itself.
#
#   issue assigned/labeled → factory guard → dev/review/rework leg
#   workflow_dispatch (SM / manual) → leg pinned by input
#
# Secrets (EXPLICIT mapping — the factory DECLARES SOURCE_GITHUB_TOKEN as a
# required named secret, and `secrets: inherit` does not satisfy
# required-secret validation at call time):
#   SOURCE_GITHUB_TOKEN (required); AI provider keys ride the generic
#   CUSTOM_PROVIDER_KEYn slots (name via CUSTOM_PROVIDER_KEYn_NAME).
name: 'AI Teammate'

run-name: >-
  ${{ github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch' &&
      format('▶ {0} (SM) · {1}', github.event.inputs.leg,
        (github.event.inputs.pr || '') != '' && format('pr-{0}', github.event.inputs.pr)
        || format('gh-{0}', github.event.inputs.issue)) ||
      github.event.label.name == 'pr_approved' && '✅ pr_approved' ||
      github.event.label.name == 'agent:rework' && '🔧 rework' ||
      github.event.label.name == 'agent:review' && '🔍 review' ||
      contains(github.event.issue.labels.*.name, 'agent:rework') && '🔧 rework' ||
      contains(github.event.issue.labels.*.name, 'agent:review') && '🔍 review' ||
      '⚒️ dev' }}
  · ${{ (github.event.inputs.pr || '') != '' && format('pr-{0}', github.event.inputs.pr)
      || format('gh-{0}', github.event.issue.number || github.event.inputs.issue) }}${{
      github.event.issue.title && format(': {0}', github.event.issue.title) || '' }}

on:
  # Human replies on needs-input tickets re-arm the dev leg via the
  # factory gate (comment-resume); PR comments are filtered by the if below.
  issue_comment:
    types: [created]
  issues:
    # assigned + labeled — the issues trigger is the dev intake (assignment
    # to the machine login); label events let the pr_approved re-entry and
    # manual agent:review/agent:rework overrides reach the guard. The awf
    # guard skips status-label echoes at evaluation.
    types: [assigned]
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      issue:
        description: 'Issue number (empty for PR-anchored runs, #687)'
        required: false
        type: string
        default: ''
      leg:
        description: 'Which leg to run'
        required: true
        type: choice
        options: [dev, review, rework]
      reason:
        description: 'Why this dispatch (audit trail, shown in logs)'
        required: false
        type: string
      pr:
        description: 'PR number for PR-anchored review runs (#687) — the SM dispatches review with pr instead of issue'
        required: false
        type: string
        default: ''

permissions:
  # The factory (factory-teammate.yml@e611e5f) requests this set and a
  # reusable workflow cannot RAISE rights above its caller — the stub must
  # grant the ceiling or every dispatch startup-fails (live dmtools-agents
  # 2026-10-03: 'requesting actions: write, contents: write, issues: write,
  # pull-requests: write, but is only allowed contents: read').
  actions: write
  contents: write
  issues: write
  pull-requests: write

concurrency:

Actually, does Image.asset in widget tests throw if the asset is missing? It would throw asynchronously (image failed to load → FlutterError reported). By default, `tester.pumpWidget` + a missing asset causes an unhandled exception reported by the framework — the test would fail. That's a nice implicit check that the asset exists and is declared. But sometimes errors surface only if we pumpAndSetle or await... The image stream error arrives asynchronously; flutter_test fails tests on unhandled FlutterError... The Image widget listens to the stream; on error it reports to FlutterError.onError which fails the test. It requires pumping until the error is delivered. With `await tester.pump()` after pumpWidget it should surface. I'll add a small pump in the logo test and also verify image cache contains the decoded image... # AI Teammate — thin stub over the factory home (dmtools-agentic-workflows).
#
# ALL logic lives in IstiN/dmtools-agentic-workflows/.github/workflows/
# factory-teammate.yml (guard, legs, verdict, sessions, memory). This file
# carries only what cannot live in a reusable workflow: the repository
# event triggers, the per-issue concurrency group, and the call itself.
#
#   issue assigned/labeled → factory guard → dev/review/rework leg
#   workflow_dispatch (SM / manual) → leg pinned by input
#
# Secrets (EXPLICIT mapping — the factory DECLARES SOURCE_GITHUB_TOKEN as a
# required named secret, and `secrets: inherit` does not satisfy
# required-secret validation at call time):
#   SOURCE_GITHUB_TOKEN (required); AI provider keys ride the generic
#   CUSTOM_PROVIDER_KEYn slots (name via CUSTOM_PROVIDER_KEYn_NAME).
name: 'AI Teammate'

run-name: >-
  ${{ github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch' &&
      format('▶ {0} (SM) · {1}', github.event.inputs.leg,
        (github.event.inputs.pr || '') != '' && format('pr-{0}', github.event.inputs.pr)
        || format('gh-{0}', github.event.inputs.issue)) ||
      github.event.label.name == 'pr_approved' && '✅ pr_approved' ||
      github.event.label.name == 'agent:rework' && '🔧 rework' ||
      github.event.label.name == 'agent:review' && '🔍 review' ||
      contains(github.event.issue.labels.*.name, 'agent:rework') && '🔧 rework' ||
      contains(github.event.issue.labels.*.name, 'agent:review') && '🔍 review' ||
      '⚒️ dev' }}
  · ${{ (github.event.inputs.pr || '') != '' && format('pr-{0}', github.event.inputs.pr)
      || format('gh-{0}', github.event.issue.number || github.event.inputs.issue) }}${{
      github.event.issue.title && format(': {0}', github.event.issue.title) || '' }}

on:
  # Human replies on needs-input tickets re-arm the dev leg via the
  # factory gate (comment-resume); PR comments are filtered by the if below.
  issue_comment:
    types: [created]
  issues:
    # assigned + labeled — the issues trigger is the dev intake (assignment
    # to the machine login); label events let the pr_approved re-entry and
    # manual agent:review/agent:rework overrides reach the guard. The awf
    # guard skips status-label echoes at evaluation.
    types: [assigned]
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      issue:
        description: 'Issue number (empty for PR-anchored runs, #687)'
        required: false
        type: string
        default: ''
      leg:
        description: 'Which leg to run'
        required: true
        type: choice
        options: [dev, review, rework]
      reason:
        description: 'Why this dispatch (audit trail, shown in logs)'
        required: false
        type: string
      pr:
        description: 'PR number for PR-anchored review runs (#687) — the SM dispatches review with pr instead of issue'
        required: false
        type: string
        default: ''

permissions:
  # The factory (factory-teammate.yml@e611e5f) requests this set and a
  # reusable workflow cannot RAISE rights above its caller — the stub must
  # grant the ceiling or every dispatch startup-fails (live dmtools-agents
  # 2026-10-03: 'requesting actions: write, contents: write, issues: write,
  # pull-requests: write, but is only allowed contents: read').
  actions: write
  contents: write
  issues: write
  pull-requests: write

concurrency:
  # PR-anchored dispatches (#544/#687) carry no issue — fall back to the pr
  # input so each PR keeps its OWN group ('ai-teammate-issue-pr-123');
  # without it every PR-anchored run shares the empty group and serializes

Actually, does Image.asset in widget tests throw if the asset is missing? It would throw asynchronously (image failed to load → FlutterError reported). name: 'AI Teammate'

run-name: >-
  ${{ github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch' &&
      format('▶ {0} (SM) · {1}', github.event.inputs.leg,
        (github.event.inputs.pr || '') != '' && format('pr-{0}', github.event.inputs.pr)

      contains(github.event.issue.labels.*.name, 'agent:review') && '🔍 review' ||

  · ${{ (github.event.inputs.pr || '') != '' && format('pr-{0}', github.event.inputs.pr)

- [ ] Login page renders on Android and iOS
- [ ] Google and Apple sign-in wired, with saved credentials / autofill where supported

# AI Teammate — thin stub over the factory home (dmtools-agentic-workflows).
#
# ALL logic lives in IstiN/dmtools-agentic-workflows/.github/workflows/
# factory-teammate.yml (guard, legs, verdict, sessions, memory). This file
# carries only what cannot live in a reusable workflow: the repository
# event triggers, the per-issue concurrency group, and the call itself.
#
#   issue assigned/labeled → factory guard → dev/review/rework leg
#   workflow_dispatch (SM / manual) → leg pinned by input
#
# Secrets (EXPLICIT mapping — the factory DECLARES SOURCE_GITHUB_TOKEN as a
# required named secret, and `secrets: inherit` does not satisfy
# required-secret validation at call time):
#   SOURCE_GITHUB_TOKEN (required); AI provider keys ride the generic
#   CUSTOM_PROVIDER_KEYn slots (name via CUSTOM_PROVIDER_KEYn_NAME).
name: 'AI Teammate'

run-name: >-
  ${{ github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch' &&
      format('▶ {0} (SM) · {1}', github.event.inputs.leg,
        (github.event.inputs.pr || '') != '' && format('pr-{0}', github.event.inputs.pr)
        || format('gh-{0}', github.event.inputs.issue)) ||
      github.event.label.name == 'pr_approved' && '✅ pr_approved' ||
      github.event.label.name == 'agent:rework' && '🔧 rework' ||
      github.event.label.name == 'agent:review' && '🔍 review' ||
      contains(github.event.issue.labels.*.name, 'agent:rework') && '🔧 rework' ||
      contains(github.event.issue.labels.*.name, 'agent:review') && '🔍 review' ||
      '⚒️ dev' }}
  · ${{ (github.event.inputs.pr || '') != '' && format('pr-{0}', github.event.inputs.pr)
      || format('gh-{0}', github.event.issue.number || github.event.inputs.issue) }}${{
      github.event.issue.title && format(': {0}', github.event.issue.title) || '' }}

on:
  # Human replies on needs-input tickets re-arm the dev leg via the
  # factory gate (comment-resume); PR comments are filtered by the if below.
  issue_comment:
    types: [created]
  issues:
    # assigned + labeled — the issues trigger is the dev intake (assignment
    # to the machine login); label events let the pr_approved re-entry and
    # manual agent:review/agent:rework overrides reach the guard. The awf
    # guard skips status-label echoes at evaluation.
    types: [assigned]
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      issue:
        description: 'Issue number (empty for PR-anchored runs, #687)'
        required: false
        type: string
        default: ''
      leg:
        description: 'Which leg to run'
        required: true
        type: choice
        options: [dev, review, rework]
      reason:
        description: 'Why this dispatch (audit trail, shown in logs)'
        required: false
        type: string
      pr:
        description: 'PR number for PR-anchored review runs (#687) — the SM dispatches review with pr instead of issue'
        required: false
        type: string
        default: ''

permissions:
  # The factory (factory-teammate.yml@e611e5f) requests this set and a
  # reusable workflow cannot RAISE rights above its caller — the stub must
  # grant the ceiling or every dispatch startup-fails (live dmtools-agents
  # 2026-10-03: 'requesting actions: write, contents: write, issues: write,
  # pull-requests: write, but is only allowed contents: read').
  actions: write
  contents: write
  issues: write
  pull-requests: write

concurrency:
  # PR-anchored dispatches (#544/#687) carry no issue — fall back to the pr
  # input so each PR keeps its OWN group ('ai-teammate-issue-pr-123');
  # without it every PR-anchored run shares the empty group and serializes

Actually, does Image.asset in widget tests throw if the asset is missing? It would throw asynchronously (image failed to load → FlutterError reported). But sometimes errors surface only if we pumpAndSetle or await... The image stream error arrives asynchronously; flutter_test fails tests on unhandled FlutterError... The Image widget listens to the stream; on error it reports to FlutterError.onError which fails the test. It requires pumping until the error is delivered. # gh-2: Create mobile Flutter project with simple login page (Google/Apple sign-in, remember me)

## Description

## Task

Create a new **mobile Flutter project** in this repository and implement a simple login page.

## Requirements

- Flutter mobile project (Android + iOS targets), clean default structure
- Login page: email/password fields, sign-in button, basic validation and error states
- **Remember me**: persist the session locally so the user stays signed in across app restarts
- **Google sign-in** integration (credential save / autofill where the platform supports it)
- **Apple sign-in** integration (per Apple guidelines)

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] `flutter pub get` and `flutter analyze` pass
- [ ] `flutter test` passes (at least a widget test for the login page)
- [ ] Login page renders on Android and iOS
- [ ] Google and Apple sign-in wired, with saved credentials / autofill where supported

# AI Teammate — thin stub over the factory home (dmtools-agentic-workflows).
#
# ALL logic lives in IstiN/dmtools-agentic-workflows/.github/workflows/
# factory-teammate.yml (guard, legs, verdict, sessions, memory). This file
# carries only what cannot live in a reusable workflow: the repository
# event triggers, the per-issue concurrency group, and the call itself.
#
#   issue assigned/labeled → factory guard → dev/review/rework leg
#   workflow_dispatch (SM / manual) → leg pinned by input
#
# Secrets (EXPLICIT mapping — the factory DECLARES SOURCE_GITHUB_TOKEN as a
# required named secret, and `secrets: inherit` does not satisfy
# required-secret validation at call time):
#   SOURCE_GITHUB_TOKEN (required); AI provider keys ride the generic
#   CUSTOM_PROVIDER_KEYn slots (name via CUSTOM_PROVIDER_KEYn_NAME).
name: 'AI Teammate'

run-name: >-
  ${{ github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch' &&
      format('▶ {0} (SM) · {1}', github.event.inputs.leg,
        (github.event.inputs.pr || '') != '' && format('pr-{0}', github.event.inputs.pr)
        || format('gh-{0}', github.event.inputs.issue)) ||
      github.event.label.name == 'pr_approved' && '✅ pr_approved' ||
      github.event.label.name == 'agent:rework' && '🔧 rework' ||
      github.event.label.name == 'agent:review' && '🔍 review' ||
      contains(github.event.issue.labels.*.name, 'agent:rework') && '🔧 rework' ||
      contains(github.event.issue.labels.*.name, 'agent:review') && '🔍 review' ||
      '⚒️ dev' }}
  · ${{ (github.event.inputs.pr || '') != '' && format('pr-{0}', github.event.inputs.pr)
      || format('gh-{0}', github.event.issue.number || github.event.inputs.issue) }}${{
      github.event.issue.title && format(': {0}', github.event.issue.title) || '' }}

on:
  # Human replies on needs-input tickets re-arm the dev leg via the
  # factory gate (comment-resume); PR comments are filtered by the if below.
  issue_comment:
    types: [created]
  issues:
    # assigned + labeled — the issues trigger is the dev intake (assignment
    # to the machine login); label events let the pr_approved re-entry and
    # manual agent:review/agent:rework overrides reach the guard. The awf
    # guard skips status-label echoes at evaluation.
    types: [assigned]
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      issue:
        description: 'Issue number (empty for PR-anchored runs, #687)'
        required: false
        type: string
        default: ''
      leg:
        description: 'Which leg to run'
        required: true
        type: choice
        options: [dev, review, rework]
      reason:
        description: 'Why this dispatch (audit trail, shown in logs)'
        required: false
        type: string
      pr:
        description: 'PR number for PR-anchored review runs (#687) — the SM dispatches review with pr instead of issue'
        required: false
        type: string
        default: ''

permissions:
  # The factory (factory-teammate.yml@e611e5f) requests this set and a
  # reusable workflow cannot RAISE rights above its caller — the stub must
  # grant the ceiling or every dispatch startup-fails (live dmtools-agents
  # 2026-10-03: 'requesting actions: write, contents: write, issues: write,
  # pull-requests: write, but is only allowed contents: read').
  actions: write
  contents: write
  issues: write
  pull-requests: write

concurrency:

  # input so each PR keeps its OWN group ('ai-teammate-issue-pr-123');

In widget tests, image assets from the package can be loaded if declared in pubspec — flutter_test can load real asset bytes when running `flutter test` (asset bundle is available). An `Image.asset` in a widget test with a real file will actually decode if the file exists. To keep tests hermetic-ish, matching by key and type is enough; plus the CI runs `flutter test` which will exercise `flutter pub get`... Actually, does Image.asset in widget tests throw if the asset is missing? It would throw asynchronously (image failed to load → FlutterError reported). By default, `tester.pumpWidget` + a missing asset causes an unhandled exception reported by the framework — the test would fail. That's a nice implicit check that the asset exists and is declared. But sometimes errors surface only if we pumpAndSetle or await... The image stream error arrives asynchronously; flutter_test fails tests on unhandled FlutterError... The Image widget listens to the stream; on error it reports to FlutterError.onError which fails the test. It requires pumping until the error is delivered. With `await tester.pump()` after pumpWidget it should surface. I'll add a small pump in the logo test and also verify image cache contains the decoded image... Keep it reasonable: pump and expect key + Image type + asset name.

# AI Teammate — thin stub over the factory home (dmtools-agentic-workflows).
#
# ALL logic lives in IstiN/dmtools-agentic-workflows/.github/workflows/
# factory-teammate.yml (guard, legs, verdict, sessions, memory). This file
# carries only what cannot live in a reusable workflow: the repository
# event triggers, the per-issue concurrency group, and the call itself.
#
#   issue assigned/labeled → factory guard → dev/review/rework leg
#   workflow_dispatch (SM / manual) → leg pinned by input
#
# Secrets (EXPLICIT mapping — the factory DECLARES SOURCE_GITHUB_TOKEN as a
# required named secret, and `secrets: inherit` does not satisfy
# required-secret validation at call time):
#   SOURCE_GITHUB_TOKEN (required); AI provider keys ride the generic
#   CUSTOM_PROVIDER_KEYn slots (name via CUSTOM_PROVIDER_KEYn_NAME).
name: 'AI Teammate'

run-name: >-
  ${{ github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch' &&
      format('▶ {0} (SM) · {1}', github.event.inputs.leg,
        (github.event.inputs.pr || '') != '' && format('pr-{0}', github.event.inputs.pr)
        || format('gh-{0}', github.event.inputs.issue)) ||
      github.event.label.name == 'pr_approved' && '✅ pr_approved' ||
      github.event.label.name == 'agent:rework' && '🔧 rework' ||
      github.event.label.name == 'agent:review' && '🔍 review' ||
      contains(github.event.issue.labels.*.name, 'agent:rework') && '🔧 rework' ||
      contains(github.event.issue.labels.*.name, 'agent:review') && '🔍 review' ||
      '⚒️ dev' }}
  · ${{ (github.event.inputs.pr || '') != '' && format('pr-{0}', github.event.inputs.pr)
      || format('gh-{0}', github.event.issue.number || github.event.inputs.issue) }}${{
      github.event.issue.title && format(': {0}', github.event.issue.title) || '' }}

on:
  # Human replies on needs-input tickets re-arm the dev leg via the
  # factory gate (comment-resume); PR comments are filtered by the if below.
  issue_comment:
    types: [created]
  issues:
    # assigned + labeled — the issues trigger is the dev intake (assignment
    # to the machine login); label events let the pr_approved re-entry and
    # manual agent:review/agent:rework overrides reach the guard. The awf
    # guard skips status-label echoes at evaluation.
    types: [assigned]
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      issue:
        description: 'Issue number (empty for PR-anchored runs, #687)'
        required: false
        type: string
        default: ''
      leg:
        description: 'Which leg to run'
        required: true
        type: choice
        options: [dev, review, rework]
      reason:
        description: 'Why this dispatch (audit trail, shown in logs)'
        required: false
        type: string
      pr:
        description: 'PR number for PR-anchored review runs (#687) — the SM dispatches review with pr instead of issue'
        required: false
        type: string
        default: ''

permissions:
  # The factory (factory-teammate.yml@e611e5f) requests this set and a
  # reusable workflow cannot RAISE rights above its caller — the stub must
  # grant the ceiling or every dispatch startup-fails (live dmtools-agents
  # 2026-10-03: 'requesting actions: write, contents: write, issues: write,
  # pull-requests: write, but is only allowed contents: read').
  actions: write
  contents: write
  issues: write
  pull-requests: write

concurrency:
  # PR-anchored dispatches (#544/#687) carry no issue — fall back to the pr
  # input so each PR keeps its OWN group ('ai-teammate-issue-pr-123');
  # without it every PR-anchored run shares the empty group and serializes

To keep tests hermetic-ish, matching by key and type is enough; plus the CI runs `flutter test` which will exercise `flutter pub get`... Actually, does Image.asset in widget tests throw if the asset is missing? It would throw asynchronously (image failed to load → FlutterError reported). By default, `tester.pumpWidget` + a missing asset causes an unhandled exception reported by the framework — the test would fail. That's a nice implicit check that the asset exists and is declared. But sometimes errors surface only if we pumpAndSetle or await... The image stream error arrives asynchronously; flutter_test fails tests on unhandled FlutterError... The Image widget listens to the stream; on error it reports to FlutterError.onError which fails the test. It requires pumping until the error is delivered. With `await tester.pump()` after pumpWidget it should surface. I'll add a small pump in the logo test and also verify image cache contains the decoded image... # AI Teammate — thin stub over the factory home (dmtools-agentic-workflows).
#
# ALL logic lives in IstiN/dmtools-agentic-workflows/.github/workflows/
# factory-teammate.yml (guard, legs, verdict, sessions, memory). This file
# carries only what cannot live in a reusable workflow: the repository
# event triggers, the per-issue concurrency group, and the call itself.
#
#   issue assigned/labeled → factory guard → dev/review/rework leg
#   workflow_dispatch (SM / manual) → leg pinned by input
#
# Secrets (EXPLICIT mapping — the factory DECLARES SOURCE_GITHUB_TOKEN as a
# required named secret, and `secrets: inherit` does not satisfy
# required-secret validation at call time):
#   SOURCE_GITHUB_TOKEN (required); AI provider keys ride the generic
#   CUSTOM_PROVIDER_KEYn slots (name via CUSTOM_PROVIDER_KEYn_NAME).
name: 'AI Teammate'

run-name: >-
  ${{ github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch' &&
      format('▶ {0} (SM) · {1}', github.event.inputs.leg,
        (github.event.inputs.pr || '') != '' && format('pr-{0}', github.event.inputs.pr)
        || format('gh-{0}', github.event.inputs.issue)) ||
      github.event.label.name == 'pr_approved' && '✅ pr_approved' ||
      github.event.label.name == 'agent:rework' && '🔧 rework' ||
      github.event.label.name == 'agent:review' && '🔍 review' ||
      contains(github.event.issue.labels.*.name, 'agent:rework') && '🔧 rework' ||
      contains(github.event.issue.labels.*.name, 'agent:review') && '🔍 review' ||
      '⚒️ dev' }}
  · ${{ (github.event.inputs.pr || '') != '' && format('pr-{0}', github.event.inputs.pr)
      || format('gh-{0}', github.event.issue.number || github.event.inputs.issue) }}${{
      github.event.issue.title && format(': {0}', github.event.issue.title) || '' }}

on:
  # Human replies on needs-input tickets re-arm the dev leg via the
  # factory gate (comment-resume); PR comments are filtered by the if below.
  issue_comment:
    types: [created]
  issues:
    # assigned + labeled — the issues trigger is the dev intake (assignment
    # to the machine login); label events let the pr_approved re-entry and
    # manual agent:review/agent:rework overrides reach the guard. The awf
    # guard skips status-label echoes at evaluation.
    types: [assigned]
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      issue:
        description: 'Issue number (empty for PR-anchored runs, #687)'
        required: false
        type: string
        default: ''
      leg:
        description: 'Which leg to run'
        required: true
        type: choice
        options: [dev, review, rework]
      reason:
        description: 'Why this dispatch (audit trail, shown in logs)'
        required: false
        type: string
      pr:
        description: 'PR number for PR-anchored review runs (#687) — the SM dispatches review with pr instead of issue'
        required: false
        type: string
        default: ''

permissions:
  # The factory (factory-teammate.yml@e611e5f) requests this set and a
  # reusable workflow cannot RAISE rights above its caller — the stub must
  # grant the ceiling or every dispatch startup-fails (live dmtools-agents
  # 2026-10-03: 'requesting actions: write, contents: write, issues: write,
  # pull-requests: write, but is only allowed contents: read').
  actions: write
  contents: write
  issues: write
  pull-requests: write

concurrency:
  # PR-anchored dispatches (#544/#687) carry no issue — fall back to the pr
  # input so each PR keeps its OWN group ('ai-teammate-issue-pr-123');
  # without it every PR-anchored run shares the empty group and serializes

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Generate the DM Tools app logo + all launcher icon sizes.

Draws a flat white gear on a vertical indigo gradient badge (matching the
app's `Colors.indigo` seed color) at 4x supersampling, then emits:
  - assets/images/app_logo.png           (1024x1024 master)
  - android mipmap ic_launcher.png        (48/72/96/144/192)
  - iOS AppIcon.appiconset PNGs           (all sizes in Contents.json)

Deterministic: no randomness, no network.
"""
from PIL import Image, ImageDraw
import math
import os

SS = 4                     # supersampling factor
MASTER = 1024
S = MASTER * SS            # working canvas size
CENTER = S / 2

INDIGO_TOP = (0x30, 0x3F, 0x9F)
INDIGO_BOTTOM = (0x79, 0x86, 0xCB)
ROOT = os.path.dirname(os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__)))


def lerp(a, b, t):
    return tuple(round(a[i] + (b[i] - a[i]) * t) for i in range(3))


def make_gradient(size):
    col = Image.new('RGB', (1, size))
    for y in range(size):
        col.putpixel((0, y), lerp(INDIGO_TOP, INDIGO_BOTTOM, y / (size - 1)))
    return col.resize((size, size))


def make_glyph(size):
    """White gear glyph (with cut-outs) as an 'L' mode mask."""
    layer = Image.new('L', (size, size), 0)
    d = ImageDraw.Draw(layer)
    cx = cy = size / 2

    body_r = 0.300 * size      # gear body radius
    tooth_in = 0.265 * size    # teeth inner radius
    tooth_out = 0.360 * size   # teeth outer radius
    hole_r = 0.115 * size      # center hole radius
    n_teeth = 8

    # Teeth: trapezoids with arc-rounded outer edge, sampled finely.
    for i in range(n_teeth):
        ang = 2 * math.pi * i / n_teeth
        half_w_in = math.pi / n_teeth * 0.62   # angular half-width at base
        half_w_out = math.pi / n_teeth * 0.38  # narrower at tip
        pts = []
        a0 = ang - half_w_in
        a1 = ang - half_w_out
        a2 = ang + half_w_out
        a3 = ang + half_w_in
        steps = 12
        for k in range(steps + 1):   # outer arc, tip side
            a = a1 + (a2 - a1) * k / steps
            pts.append((cx + tooth_out * math.cos(a),
                        cy + tooth_out * math.sin(a)))
        pts.append((cx + tooth_in * math.cos(a3), cy + tooth_in * math.sin(a3)))
        for k in range(steps + 1):   # base arc back
            a = a3 - (a3 - a0) * k / steps
            pts.append((cx + tooth_in * math.cos(a),
                        cy + tooth_in * math.sin(a)))
        d.polygon(pts, fill=255)

    # Gear body.
    d.ellipse([cx - body_r, cy - body_r, cx + body_r, cy + body_r], fill=255)

    # Center hole: punched through.
    d.ellipse([cx - hole_r, cy - hole_r, cx + hole_r, cy + hole_r], fill=0)

    # Thin decorative inner ring punched through for a machined look.
    ring_r_out = 0.210 * size
    ring_r_in = 0.188 * size
    d.ellipse([cx - ring_r_out, cy - ring_r_out, cx + ring_r_out, cy + ring_r_out], fill=0)
    d.ellipse([cx - ring_r_in, cy - ring_r_in, cx + ring_r_in, cy + ring_r_in], fill=255)
    return layer


def build_master(path):
    img = make_gradient(S).convert('RGB')
    glyph = make_glyph(S)
    white = Image.new('RGB', (S, S), (255, 255, 255))
    img.paste(white, (0, 0), glyph)
    img = img.resize((MASTER, MASTER), Image.LANCZOS)
    img.save(path, 'PNG')
    print(f'wrote {path}')


def emit(img, path):
    os.makedirs(os.path.dirname(path), exist_ok=True)
    img.resize((MASTER, MASTER), Image.LANCZOS).save(path, 'PNG')


def resample(master, size, path):
    out = master.resize((size, size), Image.LANCZOS)
    out.save(path, 'PNG')
    print(f'wrote {path} ({size}x{size})')


def main():
    master = make_gradient(S).convert('RGB')
    glyph = make_glyph(S)
    white = Image.new('RGB', (S, S), (255, 255, 255))
    master.paste(white, (0, 0), glyph)
    master = master.resize((MASTER, MASTER), Image.LANCZOS)

    resample(master, MASTER, os.path.join(ROOT, 'assets/images/app_logo.png'))

    android = [
        ('mipmap-mdpi', 48), ('mipmap-hdpi', 72), ('mipmap-xhdpi', 96),
        ('mipmap-xxhdpi', 144), ('mipmap-xxxhdpi', 192),
    ]
    for density, size in android:
        resample(master, size, os.path.join(
            ROOT, f'android/app/src/main/res/{density}/ic_launcher.png'))

    ios_sizes = [
        ('Icon-App-20x20@1x', 20), ('Icon-App-20x20@2x', 40),
        ('Icon-App-20x20@3x', 60), ('Icon-App-29x29@1x', 29),
        ('Icon-App-29x29@2x', 58), ('Icon-App-29x29@3x', 87),
        ('Icon-App-40x40@1x', 40), ('Icon-App-40x40@2x', 80),
        ('Icon-App-40x40@3x', 120), ('Icon-App-60x60@2x', 120),
        ('Icon-App-60x60@3x', 180), ('Icon-App-76x76@1x', 76),
        ('Icon-App-76x76@2x', 152), ('Icon-App-83.5x83.5@2x', 167),
        ('Icon-App-1024x1024@1x', 1024),
    ]
    for name, size in ios_sizes:
        resample(master, size, os.path.join(
            ROOT, f'ios/Runner/Assets.xcassets/AppIcon.appiconset/{name}.png'))


if __name__ == '__main__':
    main()

# AI Teammate — thin stub over the factory home (dmtools-agentic-workflows).
#
# ALL logic lives in IstiN/dmtools-agentic-workflows/.github/workflows/
# factory-teammate.yml (guard, legs, verdict, sessions, memory). This file
# carries only what cannot live in a reusable workflow: the repository
# event triggers, the per-issue concurrency group, and the call itself.
#
#   issue assigned/labeled → factory guard → dev/review/rework leg
#   workflow_dispatch (SM / manual) → leg pinned by input
#
# Secrets (EXPLICIT mapping — the factory DECLARES SOURCE_GITHUB_TOKEN as a
# required named secret, and `secrets: inherit` does not satisfy
# required-secret validation at call time):
#   SOURCE_GITHUB_TOKEN (required); AI provider keys ride the generic
#   CUSTOM_PROVIDER_KEYn slots (name via CUSTOM_PROVIDER_KEYn_NAME).
name: 'AI Teammate'

run-name: >-
  ${{ github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch' &&
      format('▶ {0} (SM) · {1}', github.event.inputs.leg,
        (github.event.inputs.pr || '') != '' && format('pr-{0}', github.event.inputs.pr)
        || format('gh-{0}', github.event.inputs.issue)) ||
      github.event.label.name == 'pr_approved' && '✅ pr_approved' ||
      github.event.label.name == 'agent:rework' && '🔧 rework' ||
      github.event.label.name == 'agent:review' && '🔍 review' ||
      contains(github.event.issue.labels.*.name, 'agent:rework') && '🔧 rework' ||
      contains(github.event.issue.labels.*.name, 'agent:review') && '🔍 review' ||
      '⚒️ dev' }}
  · ${{ (github.event.inputs.pr || '') != '' && format('pr-{0}', github.event.inputs.pr)
      || format('gh-{0}', github.event.issue.number || github.event.inputs.issue) }}${{
      github.event.issue.title && format(': {0}', github.event.issue.title) || '' }}

on:
  # Human replies on needs-input tickets re-arm the dev leg via the
  # factory gate (comment-resume); PR comments are filtered by the if below.
  issue_comment:
    types: [created]
  issues:
    # assigned + labeled — the issues trigger is the dev intake (assignment
    # to the machine login); label events let the pr_approved re-entry and
    # manual agent:review/agent:rework overrides reach the guard. The awf
    # guard skips status-label echoes at evaluation.
    types: [assigned]
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      issue:
        description: 'Issue number (empty for PR-anchored runs, #687)'
        required: false
        type: string
        default: ''
      leg:
        description: 'Which leg to run'
        required: true
        type: choice
        options: [dev, review, rework]
      reason:
        description: 'Why this dispatch (audit trail, shown in logs)'
        required: false
        type: string
      pr:
        description: 'PR number for PR-anchored review runs (#687) — the SM dispatches review with pr instead of issue'
        required: false
        type: string
        default: ''

permissions:
  # The factory (factory-teammate.yml@e611e5f) requests this set and a
  # reusable workflow cannot RAISE rights above its caller — the stub must
  # grant the ceiling or every dispatch startup-fails (live dmtools-agents
  # 2026-10-03: 'requesting actions: write, contents: write, issues: write,
  # pull-requests: write, but is only allowed contents: read').
  actions: write
  contents: write
  issues: write
  pull-requests: write

concurrency:

{"content":"#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Generate the DM Tools app logo + all launcher icon sizes.

Draws a flat white gear on a vertical indigo gradient badge (matching the
app's `Colors.indigo` seed color) at 4x supersampling, then emits:
  - assets/images/app_logo.png           (1024x1024 master)
  - android mipmap ic_launcher.png        (48/72/96/144/192)
  - iOS AppIcon.appiconset PNGs           (all sizes in Contents.json)

Deterministic: no randomness, no network.
"""
from PIL import Image, ImageDraw
import math
import os

SS = 4                     # supersampling factor
MASTER = 1024
S = MASTER * SS            # working canvas size
CENTER = S / 2

INDIGO_TOP = (0x30, 0x3F, 0x9F)
INDIGO_BOTTOM = (0x79, 0x86, 0xCB)
ROOT = os.path.dirname(os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__)))


def lerp(a, b, t):
    return tuple(round(a[i] + (b[i] - a[i]) * t) for i in range(3))


def make_gradient(size):
    col = Image.new('RGB', (1, size))
    for y in range(size):
        col.putpixel((0, y), lerp(INDIGO_TOP, INDIGO_BOTTOM, y / (size - 1)))
    return col.resize((size, size))


def make_glyph(size):
    """White gear glyph (with cut-outs) as an 'L' mode mask."""
    layer = Image.new('L', (size, size), 0)
    d = ImageDraw.Draw(layer)
    cx = cy = size / 2

    body_r = 0.300 * size      # gear body radius
    tooth_in = 0.265 * size    # teeth inner radius
    tooth_out = 0.360 * size   # teeth outer radius
    hole_r = 0.115 * size      # center hole radius
    n_teeth = 8

    # Teeth: trapezoids with arc-rounded outer edge, sampled finely.
    for i in range(n_teeth):
        ang = 2 * math.pi * i / n_teeth
        half_w_in = math.pi / n_teeth * 0.62   # angular half-width at base
        half_w_out = math.pi / n_teeth * 0.38  # narrower at tip
        pts = []
        a0 = ang - half_w_in
        a1 = ang - half_w_out
        a2 = ang + half_w_out
        a3 = ang + half_w_in
        steps = 12
        for k in range(steps + 1):   # outer arc, tip side
            a = a1 + (a2 - a1) * k / steps
            pts.append((cx + tooth_out * math.cos(a),
                        cy + tooth_out * math.sin(a)))
        pts.append((cx + tooth_in * math.cos(a3), cy + tooth_in * math.sin(a3)))
        for k in range(steps + 1):   # base arc back
            a = a3 - (a3 - a0) * k / steps
            pts.append((cx + tooth_in * math.cos(a),
                        cy + tooth_in * math.sin(a)))
        d.polygon(pts, fill=255)

    # Gear body.
    d.ellipse([cx - body_r, cy - body_r, cx + body_r, cy + body_r], fill=255)

    # Center hole: punched through.
    d.ellipse([cx - hole_r, cy - hole_r, cx + hole_r, cy + hole_r], fill=0)

    # Thin decorative inner ring punched through for a machined look.
    ring_r_out = 0.210 * size
    ring_r_in = 0.188 * size
    d.ellipse([cx - ring_r_out, cy - ring_r_out, cx + ring_r_out, cy + ring_r_out], fill=0)
    d.ellipse([cx - ring_r_in, cy - ring_r_in, cx + ring_r_in, cy + ring_r_in], fill=255)
    return layer


def build_master(path):
    img = make_gradient(S).convert('RGB')
    glyph = make_glyph(S)
    white = Image.new('RGB', (S, S), (255, 255, 255))
    img.paste(white, (0, 0), glyph)
    img = img.resize((MASTER, MASTER), Image.LANCZOS)
    img.save(path, 'PNG')
    print(f'wrote {path}')


def emit(img, path):
    os.makedirs(os.path.dirname(path), exist_ok=True)
    img.resize((MASTER, MASTER), Image.LANCZOS).save(path, 'PNG')


def resample(master, size, path):
    out = master.resize((size, size), Image.LANCZOS)
    out.save(path, 'PNG')
    print(f'wrote {path} ({size}x{size})')


def main():
    master = make_gradient(S).convert('RGB')
    glyph = make_glyph(S)
    white = Image.new('RGB', (S, S), (255, 255, 255))
    master.paste(white, (0, 0), glyph)
    master = master.resize((MASTER, MASTER), Image.LANCZOS)

    resample(master, MASTER, os.path.join(ROOT, 'assets/images/app_logo.png'))

    android = [
        ('mipmap-mdpi', 48), ('mipmap-hdpi', 72), ('mipmap-xhdpi', 96),
        ('mipmap-xxhdpi', 144), ('mipmap-xxxhdpi', 192),
    ]
    for density, size in android:
        resample(master, size, os.path.join(
            ROOT, f'android/app/src/main/res/{density}/ic_launcher.png'))

    ios_sizes = [
        ('Icon-App-20x20@1x', 20), ('Icon-App-20x20@2x', 40),
        ('Icon-App-20x20@3x', 60), ('Icon-App-29x29@1x', 29),
        ('Icon-App-29x29@2x', 58), ('Icon-App-29x29@3x', 87),
        ('Icon-App-40x40@1x', 40), ('Icon-App-40x40@2x', 80),
        ('Icon-App-40x40@3x', 120), ('Icon-App-60x60@2x', 120),
        ('Icon-App-60x60@3x', 180), ('Icon-App-76x76@1x', 76),
        ('Icon-App-76x76@2x', 152), ('Icon-App-83.5x83.5@2x', 167),
        ('Icon-App-1024x1024@1x', 1024),
    ]
    for name, size in ios_sizes:
        resample(master, size, os.path.join(
            ROOT, f'ios/Runner/Assets.xcassets/AppIcon.appiconset/{name}.png'))

# AI Teammate — thin stub over the factory home (dmtools-agentic-workflows).
#
# ALL logic lives in IstiN/dmtools-agentic-workflows/.github/workflows/
# factory-teammate.yml (guard, legs, verdict, sessions, memory). This file
# carries only what cannot live in a reusable workflow: the repository
# event triggers, the per-issue concurrency group, and the call itself.
#
#   issue assigned/labeled → factory guard → dev/review/rework leg
#   workflow_dispatch (SM / manual) → leg pinned by input
#
# Secrets (EXPLICIT mapping — the factory DECLARES SOURCE_GITHUB_TOKEN as a
# required named secret, and `secrets: inherit` does not satisfy
# required-secret validation at call time):
#   SOURCE_GITHUB_TOKEN (required); AI provider keys ride the generic
#   CUSTOM_PROVIDER_KEYn slots (name via CUSTOM_PROVIDER_KEYn_NAME).
name: 'AI Teammate'

run-name: >-
  ${{ github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch' &&
      format('▶ {0} (SM) · {1}', github.event.inputs.leg,
        (github.event.inputs.pr || '') != '' && format('pr-{0}', github.event.inputs.pr)
        || format('gh-{0}', github.event.inputs.issue)) ||
      github.event.label.name == 'pr_approved' && '✅ pr_approved' ||
      github.event.label.name == 'agent:rework' && '🔧 rework' ||
      github.event.label.name == 'agent:review' && '🔍 review' ||
      contains(github.event.issue.labels.*.name, 'agent:rework') && '🔧 rework' ||
      contains(github.event.issue.labels.*.name, 'agent:review') && '🔍 review' ||
      '⚒️ dev' }}
  · ${{ (github.event.inputs.pr || '') != '' && format('pr-{0}', github.event.inputs.pr)
      || format('gh-{0}', github.event.issue.number || github.event.inputs.issue) }}${{
      github.event.issue.title && format(': {0}', github.event.issue.title) || '' }}

on:
  # Human replies on needs-input tickets re-arm the dev leg via the
  # factory gate (comment-resume); PR comments are filtered by the if below.
  issue_comment:
    types: [created]
  issues:
    # assigned + labeled — the issues trigger is the dev intake (assignment
    # to the machine login); label events let the pr_approved re-entry and
    # manual agent:review/agent:rework overrides reach the guard. The awf
    # guard skips status-label echoes at evaluation.
    types: [assigned]
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      issue:
        description: 'Issue number (empty for PR-anchored runs, #687)'
        required: false
        type: string
        default: ''
      leg:
        description: 'Which leg to run'
        required: true
        type: choice
        options: [dev, review, rework]
      reason:
        description: 'Why this dispatch (audit trail, shown in logs)'
        required: false
        type: string
      pr:
        description: 'PR number for PR-anchored review runs (#687) — the SM dispatches review with pr instead of issue'
        required: false
        type: string
        default: ''

permissions:
  # The factory (factory-teammate.yml@e611e5f) requests this set and a
  # reusable workflow cannot RAISE rights above its caller — the stub must
  # grant the ceiling or every dispatch startup-fails (live dmtools-agents
  # 2026-10-03: 'requesting actions: write, contents: write, issues: write,
  # pull-requests: write, but is only allowed contents: read').
  actions: write
  contents: write
  issues: write
  pull-requests: write

concurrency:
  # PR-anchored dispatches (#544/#687) carry no issue — fall back to the pr
  # input so each PR keeps its OWN group ('ai-teammate-issue-pr-123');
  # without it every PR-anchored run shares the empty group and serializes

{"content":"#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Generate the DM Tools app logo + all launcher icon sizes.

Draws a flat white gear on a vertical indigo gradient badge (matching the
app's `Colors.indigo` seed color) at 4x supersampling, then emits:
  - assets/images/app_logo.png           (1024x1024 master)
  - android mipmap ic_launcher.png        (48/72/96/144/192)
  - iOS AppIcon.appiconset PNGs           (all sizes in Contents.json)

Deterministic: no randomness, no network.
"""
from PIL import Image, ImageDraw
import math
import os

SS = 4                     # supersampling factor
MASTER = 1024
S = MASTER * SS            # working canvas size
CENTER = S / 2

INDIGO_TOP = (0x30, 0x3F, 0x9F)
INDIGO_BOTTOM = (0x79, 0x86, 0xCB)
ROOT = os.path.dirname(os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__)))


def lerp(a, b, t):
    return tuple(round(a[i] + (b[i] - a[i]) * t) for i in range(3))


def make_gradient(size):
    col = Image.new('RGB', (1, size))
    for y in range(size):
        col.putpixel((0, y), lerp(INDIGO_TOP, INDIGO_BOTTOM, y / (size - 1)))
    return col.resize((size, size))


def make_glyph(size):
    """White gear glyph (with cut-outs) as an 'L' mode mask."""
    layer = Image.new('L', (size, size), 0)
    d = ImageDraw.Draw(layer)
    cx = cy = size / 2

    body_r = 0.300 * size      # gear body radius
    tooth_in = 0.265 * size    # teeth inner radius
    tooth_out = 0.360 * size   # teeth outer radius
    hole_r = 0.115 * size      # center hole radius
    n_teeth = 8

    # Teeth: trapezoids with arc-rounded outer edge, sampled finely.
    for i in range(n_teeth):
        ang = 2 * math.pi * i / n_teeth
        half_w_in = math.pi / n_teeth * 0.62   # angular half-width at base
        half_w_out = math.pi / n_teeth * 0.38  # narrower at tip
        pts = []
        a0 = ang - half_w_in
        a1 = ang - half_w_out
        a2 = ang + half_w_out
        a3 = ang + half_w_in
        steps = 12
        for k in range(steps + 1):   # outer arc, tip side
            a = a1 + (a2 - a1) * k / steps
            pts.append((cx + tooth_out * math.cos(a),
                        cy + tooth_out * math.sin(a)))
        pts.append((cx + tooth_in * math.cos(a3), cy + tooth_in * math.sin(a3)))
        for k in range(steps + 1):   # base arc back
            a = a3 - (a3 - a0) * k / steps
            pts.append((cx + tooth_in * math.cos(a),
                        cy + tooth_in * math.sin(a)))
        d.polygon(pts, fill=255)

    # Gear body.
    d.ellipse([cx - body_r, cy - body_r, cx + body_r, cy + body_r], fill=255)

    # Center hole: punched through.
    d.ellipse([cx - hole_r, cy - hole_r, cx + hole_r, cy + hole_r], fill=0)

    # Thin decorative inner ring punched through for a machined look.
    ring_r_out = 0.210 * size
    ring_r_in = 0.188 * size
    d.ellipse([cx - ring_r_out, cy - ring_r_out, cx + ring_r_out, cy + ring_r_out], fill=0)
    d.ellipse([cx - ring_r_in, cy - ring_r_in, cx + ring_r_in, cy + ring_r_in], fill=255)
    return layer


def build_master(path):
    img = make_gradient(S).convert('RGB')
    glyph = make_glyph(S)
    white = Image.new('RGB', (S, S), (255, 255, 255))
    img.paste(white, (0, 0), glyph)
    img = img.resize((MASTER, MASTER), Image.LANCZOS)
    img.save(path, 'PNG')
    print(f'wrote {path}')


def emit(img, path):
    os.makedirs(os.path.dirname(path), exist_ok=True)
    img.resize((MASTER, MASTER), Image.LANCZOS).save(path, 'PNG')


def resample(master, size, path):
    out = master.resize((size, size), Image.LANCZOS)
    out.save(path, 'PNG')
    print(f'wrote {path} ({size}x{size})')


def main():
    master = make_gradient(S).convert('RGB')
    glyph = make_glyph(S)
    white = Image.new('RGB', (S, S), (255, 255, 255))
    master.paste(white, (0, 0), glyph)
    master = master.resize((MASTER, MASTER), Image.LANCZOS)

    resample(master, MASTER, os.path.join(ROOT, 'assets/images/app_logo.png'))

    android = [
        ('mipmap-mdpi', 48), ('mipmap-hdpi', 72), ('mipmap-xhdpi', 96),
        ('mipmap-xxhdpi', 144), ('mipmap-xxxhdpi', 192),
    ]
    for density, size in android:
        resample(master, size, os.path.join(
            ROOT, f'android/app/src/main/res/{density}/ic_launcher.png'))

    ios_sizes = [
        ('Icon-App-20x20@1x', 20), ('Icon-App-20x20@2x', 40),
        ('Icon-App-20x20@3x', 60), ('Icon-App-29x29@1x', 29),
        ('Icon-App-29x29@2x', 58), ('Icon-App-29x29@3x', 87),
        ('Icon-App-40x40@1x', 40), ('Icon-App-40x40@2x', 80),
        ('Icon-App-40x40@3x', 120), ('Icon-App-60x60@2x', 120),
        ('Icon-App-60x60@3x', 180), ('Icon-App-76x76@1x', 76),
        ('Icon-App-76x76@2x', 152), ('Icon-App-83.5x83.5@2x', 167),
        ('Icon-App-1024x1024@1x', 1024),
    ]
    for name, size in ios_sizes:
        resample(master, size, os.path.join(
            ROOT, f'ios/Runner/Assets.xcassets/AppIcon.appiconset/{name}.png'))


if __name__ == '__main__':
    main()

# AI Teammate — thin stub over the factory home (dmtools-agentic-workflows).
#
# ALL logic lives in IstiN/dmtools-agentic-workflows/.github/workflows/
# factory-teammate.yml (guard, legs, verdict, sessions, memory). This file
# carries only what cannot live in a reusable workflow: the repository
# event triggers, the per-issue concurrency group, and the call itself.
#
#   issue assigned/labeled → factory guard → dev/review/rework leg
#   workflow_dispatch (SM / manual) → leg pinned by input
#
# Secrets (EXPLICIT mapping — the factory DECLARES SOURCE_GITHUB_TOKEN as a
# required named secret, and `secrets: inherit` does not satisfy
# required-secret validation at call time):
#   SOURCE_GITHUB_TOKEN (required); AI provider keys ride the generic
#   CUSTOM_PROVIDER_KEYn slots (name via CUSTOM_PROVIDER_KEYn_NAME).
name: 'AI Teammate'

run-name: >-
  ${{ github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch' &&
      format('▶ {0} (SM) · {1}', github.event.inputs.leg,
        (github.event.inputs.pr || '') != '' && format('pr-{0}', github.event.inputs.pr)
        || format('gh-{0}', github.event.inputs.issue)) ||
      github.event.label.name == 'pr_approved' && '✅ pr_approved' ||
      github.event.label.name == 'agent:rework' && '🔧 rework' ||
      github.event.label.name == 'agent:review' && '🔍 review' ||
      contains(github.event.issue.labels.*.name, 'agent:rework') && '🔧 rework' ||
      contains(github.event.issue.labels.*.name, 'agent:review') && '🔍 review' ||
      '⚒️ dev' }}
  · ${{ (github.event.inputs.pr || '') != '' && format('pr-{0}', github.event.inputs.pr)
      || format('gh-{0}', github.event.issue.number || github.event.inputs.issue) }}${{
      github.event.issue.title && format(': {0}', github.event.issue.title) || '' }}

on:
  # Human replies on needs-input tickets re-arm the dev leg via the
  # factory gate (comment-resume); PR comments are filtered by the if below.
  issue_comment:
    types: [created]
  issues:
    # assigned + labeled — the issues trigger is the dev intake (assignment
    # to the machine login); label events let the pr_approved re-entry and
    # manual agent:review/agent:rework overrides reach the guard. The awf
    # guard skips status-label echoes at evaluation.
    types: [assigned]
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      issue:
        description: 'Issue number (empty for PR-anchored runs, #687)'
        required: false
        type: string
        default: ''
      leg:
        description: 'Which leg to run'
        required: true
        type: choice
        options: [dev, review, rework]
      reason:
        description: 'Why this dispatch (audit trail, shown in logs)'
        required: false
        type: string
      pr:
        description: 'PR number for PR-anchored review runs (#687) — the SM dispatches review with pr instead of issue'
        required: false
        type: string
        default: ''

permissions:
  # The factory (factory-teammate.yml@e611e5f) requests this set and a
  # reusable workflow cannot RAISE rights above its caller — the stub must
  # grant the ceiling or every dispatch startup-fails (live dmtools-agents
  # 2026-10-03: 'requesting actions: write, contents: write, issues: write,
  # pull-requests: write, but is only allowed contents: read').
  actions: write
  contents: write
  issues: write
  pull-requests: write

concurrency:
  # PR-anchored dispatches (#544/#687) carry no issue — fall back to the pr
  # input so each PR keeps its OWN group ('ai-teammate-issue-pr-123');
  # without it every PR-anchored run shares the empty group and serializes

{"content":"#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Generate the DM Tools app logo + all launcher icon sizes.

Draws a flat white gear on a vertical indigo gradient badge (matching the
app's `Colors.indigo` seed color) at 4x supersampling, then emits:
  - assets/images/app_logo.png           (1024x1024 master)
  - android mipmap ic_launcher.png        (48/72/96/144/192)
  - iOS AppIcon.appiconset PNGs           (all sizes in Contents.json)

Deterministic: no randomness, no network.
"""
from PIL import Image, ImageDraw
import math
import os

SS = 4                     # supersampling factor
MASTER = 1024
S = MASTER * SS            # working canvas size
CENTER = S / 2

INDIGO_TOP = (0x30, 0x3F, 0x9F)
INDIGO_BOTTOM = (0x79, 0x86, 0xCB)
ROOT = os.path.dirname(os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__)))


def lerp(a, b, t):
    return tuple(round(a[i] + (b[i] - a[i]) * t) for i in range(3))


def make_gradient(size):
    col = Image.new('RGB', (1, size))
    for y in range(size):
        col.putpixel((0, y), lerp(INDIGO_TOP, INDIGO_BOTTOM, y / (size - 1)))
    return col.resize((size, size))


def make_glyph(size):
    """White gear glyph (with cut-outs) as an 'L' mode mask."""
    layer = Image.new('L', (size, size), 0)
    d = ImageDraw.Draw(layer)
    cx = cy = size / 2

    body_r = 0.300 * size      # gear body radius
    tooth_in = 0.265 * size    # teeth inner radius
    tooth_out = 0.360 * size   # teeth outer radius
    hole_r = 0.115 * size      # center hole radius
    n_teeth = 8

    # Teeth: trapezoids with arc-rounded outer edge, sampled finely.
    for i in range(n_teeth):
        ang = 2 * math.pi * i / n_teeth
        half_w_in = math.pi / n_teeth * 0.62   # angular half-width at base
        half_w_out = math.pi / n_teeth * 0.38  # narrower at tip
        pts = []
        a0 = ang - half_w_in
        a1 = ang - half_w_out
        a2 = ang + half_w_out
        a3 = ang + half_w_in
        steps = 12
        for k in range(steps + 1):   # outer arc, tip side
            a = a1 + (a2 - a1) * k / steps
            pts.append((cx + tooth_out * math.cos(a),
                        cy + tooth_out * math.sin(a)))
        pts.append((cx + tooth_in * math.cos(a3), cy + tooth_in * math.sin(a3)))
        for k in range(steps + 1):   # base arc back
            a = a3 - (a3 - a0) * k / steps
            pts.append((cx + tooth_in * math.cos(a),
                        cy + tooth_in * math.sin(a)))
        d.polygon(pts, fill=255)

    # Gear body.
    d.ellipse([cx - body_r, cy - body_r, cx + body_r, cy + body_r], fill=255)

    # Center hole: punched through.
    d.ellipse([cx - hole_r, cy - hole_r, cx + hole_r, cy + hole_r], fill=0)

    # Thin decorative inner ring punched through for a machined look.
    ring_r_out = 0.210 * size
    ring_r_in = 0.188 * size
    d.ellipse([cx - ring_r_out, cy - ring_r_out, cx + ring_r_out, cy + ring_r_out], fill=0)
    d.ellipse([cx - ring_r_in, cy - ring_r_in, cx + ring_r_in, cy + ring_r_in], fill=255)
    return layer


def build_master(path):
    img = make_gradient(S).convert('RGB')
    glyph = make_glyph(S)
    white = Image.new('RGB', (S, S), (255, 255, 255))
    img.paste(white, (0, 0), glyph)
    img = img.resize((MASTER, MASTER), Image.LANCZOS)
    img.save(path, 'PNG')
    print(f'wrote {path}')


def emit(img, path):
    os.makedirs(os.path.dirname(path), exist_ok=True)
    img.resize((MASTER, MASTER), Image.LANCZOS).save(path, 'PNG')


def resample(master, size, path):
    out = master.resize((size, size), Image.LANCZOS)
    out.save(path, 'PNG')
    print(f'wrote {path} ({size}x{size})')


def main():
    master = make_gradient(S).convert('RGB')
    glyph = make_glyph(S)
    white = Image.new('RGB', (S, S), (255, 255, 255))
    master.paste(white, (0, 0), glyph)
    master = master.resize((MASTER, MASTER), Image.LANCZOS)

    resample(master, MASTER, os.path.join(ROOT, 'assets/images/app_logo.png'))

    android = [
        ('mipmap-mdpi', 48), ('mipmap-hdpi', 72), ('mipmap-xhdpi', 96),
        ('mipmap-xxhdpi', 144), ('mipmap-xxxhdpi', 192),
    ]
    for density, size in android:
        resample(master, size, os.path.join(
            ROOT, f'android/app/src/main/res/{density}/ic_launcher.png'))

    ios_sizes = [
        ('Icon-App-20x20@1x', 20), ('Icon-App-20x20@2x', 40),
        ('Icon-App-20x20@3x', 60), ('Icon-App-29x29@1x', 29),
        ('Icon-App-29x29@2x', 58), ('Icon-App-29x29@3x', 87),
        ('Icon-App-40x40@1x', 40), ('Icon-App-40x40@2x', 80),
        ('Icon-App-40x40@3x', 120), ('Icon-App-60x60@2x', 120),
        ('Icon-App-60x60@3x', 180), ('Icon-App-76x76@1x', 76),
        ('Icon-App-76x76@2x', 152), ('Icon-App-83.5x83.5@2x', 167),
        ('Icon-App-1024x1024@1x', 1024),
    ]
    for name, size in ios_sizes:
        resample(master, size, os.path.join(
            ROOT, f'ios/Runner/Assets.xcassets/AppIcon.appiconset/{name}.png'))


if __name__ == '__main__':
    main()

name: 'AI Teammate'

run-name: >-
  ${{ github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch' &&
      format('▶ {0} (SM) · {1}', github.event.inputs.leg,
        (github.event.inputs.pr || '') != '' && format('pr-{0}', github.event.inputs.pr)

      contains(github.event.issue.labels.*.name, 'agent:review') && '🔍 review' ||

  · ${{ (github.event.inputs.pr || '') != '' && format('pr-{0}', github.event.inputs.pr)
