All required context — ticket description, PR diff, CI status, and related materials — has already been prepared in the `input/` folder. Your job is to follow the instructions below, read the prepared context from `input/`, and perform the work described. Do not ask for identifiers; the context is already available locally. ## coding_guidelines.md ```mermaid flowchart TD G1["⚠️ Coding Guidelines — follow existing codebase patterns and conventions"] G2["Before implementing, explore the project's code structure, architecture, and testing patterns"] G3["If AGENTS.md exists in project root or subdirectories → READ and FOLLOW it — it contains agent-specific instructions, coding styles, and conventions"] G4["If skills are available in the project → USE them — they provide specialized capabilities, workflows, and tool integrations"] G5["Instructions may be extended via project configuration — always follow the full set of provided instructions"] G6["Never invent new patterns when the codebase already has an established way of doing things"] G1 --> G2 --> G3 --> G4 --> G5 --> G6 ``` ## input_context_reading.md ```mermaid flowchart TD subgraph INPUT_ORDER["⚠️ MANDATORY: Read input files FIRST before anything else"] I0["find input/ -type f | sort — list all available files"] I1["1️⃣ instruction.md (repo root) — project stack, deployment constraints, approved frameworks"] I2["2️⃣ input/TICKET/request.md — ticket description, requirements, solution design, diagrams"] I3["3️⃣ input/TICKET/comments.md — existing discussion, prior decisions, linked info"] I4["4️⃣ input/TICKET/existing_questions.json — answered questions = binding requirements"] I5["5️⃣ input/TICKET/confluence/*.md — specifications already downloaded"] I6["6️⃣ Check for images in input/TICKET/ — *.png *.jpg *.gif *.svg"] I7["7️⃣ If present: input/TICKET/parent-KEY.md — parent story summary, description, ACs"] I8["8️⃣ If present: input/TICKET/parent_context_ba.md / sa.md / vd.md — BA/SA/VD context"] I0 --> I1 --> I2 --> I3 --> I4 --> I5 --> I6 --> I7 --> I8 end subgraph CONFLUENCE_RULE["Confluence pages in input/ — READ THEM, don't re-fetch"] C1["✅ DO: read input/TICKET/confluence/PageName.md"] C2["❌ DON'T: call dmtools confluence_* to re-fetch pages already in input/"] C3["✅ DO: read image files in input/TICKET/confluence/ — they are attachments from that page"] end subgraph ATTACH_RULE["Attachments — check before fetching via API"] A1["Search glob 'input/**/*.png' and 'input/**/*.jpg' — find pre-downloaded images"] A2["If image found locally → analyze it directly, no API call needed"] A3["If attachment NOT in input/ → use dmtools confluence_get_content_attachments "] A1 --> A2 A1 -->|not found| A3 end subgraph DMTOOLS_RULE["When to use dmtools for external data"] D1["ONLY if you need data NOT already in input/"] D2["dmtools jira_get_ticket KEY, dmtools confluence_search QUERY, etc."] D3["See instructions/common/dmtools_cli.md for full reference"] end INPUT_ORDER --> CONFLUENCE_RULE --> ATTACH_RULE --> DMTOOLS_RULE ``` ## general_guidelines.md ```mermaid flowchart TD START([Story ticket ready for development]) --> READ_INPUT["⚠️ MANDATORY: Read ALL input files FIRST — see instructions/common/input_context_reading.md"] READ_INPUT --> PREFLIGHT{"⚠️ STEP 0 input-completeness pre-flight:

If there ARE highlights — do NOT implement. Instead: 1. Post ONE comment on the ticket asking for exactly the missing items. Be specific; propose nothing, assume nothing. 2. Write `outputs/needs-input.md` listing the missing items (same content as the comment). 3. Make NO code changes and stop. The pipeline labels the ticket `ai_questions_asked` and ends the leg without a PR. If there are NO highlights — continue with the normal flow. **Hard rules — these overrides are NOT yours to make:** - NEVER generate, synthesize, or substitute a placeholder for a missing attachment (no "a logo will do", no generated stand-ins). An unattended run is NOT a license to improvise. - NEVER assume a value for missing data "to keep the leg moving". - If missing information surfaces DURING implementation, stop the same way (comment + `outputs/needs-input.md`, no further code changes) instead of guessing. ## tdd_approach.md ```mermaid flowchart TD subgraph TDD["TDD — Test-Driven Development Workflow"] T0["Start with a clear understanding of the requirement"] T1["RED: Write a failing unit test FIRST

— run tests after every change"] T4{"More requirements to…

{"content":"#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Generate the DM Tools app logo + all launcher icon sizes.

Source artwork: the Android robot logo, provided by the ticket requester
(https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/thumb/d/d7/Android_robot.svg/200px-Android_robot.svg.png
— same SVG rendered at 960px, the largest Wikimedia-served size; committed at
tool/logo_source/android_robot_960.png). The Android robot is reproduced from
work created and shared by Google, used according to the Creative Commons 3.0
Attribution License.

The robot is centered on an opaque white square badge (platform icon masks
require an opaque square; the badge keeps Android and iOS consistent), and
all sizes are emitted:

  - assets/images/app_logo.png           (1024x1024 master, in-app)
  - android mipmap ic_launcher.png        (48/72/96/144/192)
  - iOS AppIcon.appiconset PNGs           (all sizes in Contents.json)

Deterministic: no randomness, no network (uses the committed source).
"""
from PIL import Image
import os

MASTER = 1024
ROBOT_HEIGHT_RATIO = 0.68          # robot height as a fraction of the badge
ROOT = os.path.dirname(os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__)))
SOURCE = os.path.join(ROOT, 'tool/logo_source/android_robot_960.png')


def build_master():
    robot = Image.open(SOURCE).convert('RGBA')
    h = round(MASTER * ROBOT_HEIGHT_RATIO)
    w = round(h * robot.width / robot.height)
    robot = robot.resize((w, h), Image.LANCZOS)

    badge = Image.new('RGB', (MASTER, MASTER), (255, 255, 255))
    offset = ((MASTER - w) // 2, (MASTER - h) // 2)
    badge.paste(robot, offset, robot)   # paste with alpha as mask
    return badge


def resample(master, size, path):
    os.makedirs(os.path.dirname(path), exist_ok=True)
    out = master.resize((size, size), Image.LANCZOS)
    out.save(path, 'PNG')
    print(f'wrote {path} ({size}x{size})')


def main():
    master = build_master()

    resample(master, MASTER, os.path.join(ROOT, 'assets/images/app_logo.png'))

    android = [
        ('mipmap-mdpi', 48), ('mipmap-hdpi', 72), ('mipmap-xhdpi', 96),
        ('mipmap-xxhdpi', 144), ('mipmap-xxxhdpi', 192),
    ]
    for density, size in android:
        resample(master, size, os.path.join(
            ROOT, f'android/app/src/main/res/{density}/ic_launcher.png'))

    ios_sizes = [
        ('Icon-App-20x20@1x', 20), ('Icon-App-20x20@2x', 40),
        ('Icon-App-20x20@3x', 60), ('Icon-App-29x29@1x', 29),
        ('Icon-App-29x29@2x', 58), ('Icon-App-29x29@3x', 87),
        ('Icon-App-40x40@1x', 40), ('Icon-App-40x40@2x', 80),
        ('Icon-App-40x40@3x', 120), ('Icon-App-60x60@2x', 120),
        ('Icon-App-60x60@3x', 180), ('Icon-App-76x76@1x', 76),
        ('Icon-App-76x76@2x', 152), ('Icon-App-83.5x83.5@2x', 167),
        ('Icon-App-1024x1024@1x', 1024),
    ]
    for name, size in ios_sizes:
        resample(master, size, os.path.join(
            ROOT, f'ios/Runner/Assets.xcassets/AppIcon.appiconset/{name}.png'))


if __name__ == '__main__':
    main()
","path":"tool/generate_icons.py"}

{"content":"#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Generate the DM Tools app logo + all launcher icon sizes.

Source artwork: the Android robot logo, provided by the ticket requester
(https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/thumb/d/d7/Android_robot.svg/200px-Android_robot.svg.png
— same SVG rendered at 960px, the largest Wikimedia-served size; committed at
tool/logo_source/android_robot_960.png). The Android robot is reproduced from
work created and shared by Google, used according to the Creative Commons 3.0
Attribution License.

The robot is centered on an opaque white square badge (platform icon masks
require an opaque square; the badge keeps Android and iOS consistent), and
all sizes are emitted:

  - assets/images/app_logo.png           (1024x1024 master, in-app)
  - android mipmap ic_launcher.png        (48/72/96/144/192)
  - iOS AppIcon.appiconset PNGs           (all sizes in Contents.json)

Deterministic: no randomness, no network (uses the committed source).
"""
from PIL import Image
import os

MASTER = 1024
ROBOT_HEIGHT_RATIO = 0.68          # robot height as a fraction of the badge
ROOT = os.path.dirname(os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__)))
SOURCE = os.path.join(ROOT, 'tool/logo_source/android_robot_960.png')


def build_master():
    robot = Image.open(SOURCE).convert('RGBA')
    h = round(MASTER * ROBOT_HEIGHT_RATIO)
    w = round(h * robot.width / robot.height)
    robot = robot.resize((w, h), Image.LANCZOS)

    badge = Image.new('RGB', (MASTER, MASTER), (255, 255, 255))
    offset = ((MASTER - w) // 2, (MASTER - h) // 2)
    badge.paste(robot, offset, robot)   # paste with alpha as mask
    return badge


def resample(master, size, path):
    os.makedirs(os.path.dirname(path), exist_ok=True)
    out = master.resize((size, size), Image.LANCZOS)
    out.save(path, 'PNG')
    print(f'wrote {path} ({size}x{size})')


def main():
    master = build_master()

    resample(master, MASTER, os.path.join(ROOT, 'assets/images/app_logo.png'))

    android = [
        ('mipmap-mdpi', 48), ('mipmap-hdpi', 72), ('mipmap-xhdpi', 96),
        ('mipmap-xxhdpi', 144), ('mipmap-xxxhdpi', 192),
    ]
    for density, size in android:
        resample(master, size, os.path.join(
            ROOT, f'android/app/src/main/res/{density}/ic_launcher.png'))

    ios_sizes = [
        ('Icon-App-20x20@1x', 20), ('Icon-App-20x20@2x', 40),
        ('Icon-App-20x20@3x', 60), ('Icon-App-29x29@1x', 29),
        ('Icon-App-29x29@2x', 58), ('Icon-App-29x29@3x', 87),
        ('Icon-App-40x40@1x', 40), ('Icon-App-40x40@2x', 80),
        ('Icon-App-40x40@3x', 120), ('Icon-App-60x60@2x', 120),
        ('Icon-App-60x60@3x', 180), ('Icon-App-76x76@1x', 76),
        ('Icon-App-76x76@2x', 152), ('Icon-App-83.5x83.5@2x', 167),
        ('Icon-App-1024x1024@1x', 1024),
    ]
    for name, size in ios_sizes:
        resample(master, size, os.path.join(
            ROOT, f'ios/Runner/Assets.xcassets/AppIcon.appiconset/{name}.png'))


if __name__ == '__main__':
    main()
","path":"tool/generate_icons.py"}

{"content":"#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Generate the DM Tools app logo + all launcher icon sizes.

Source artwork: the Android robot logo, provided by the ticket requester
(https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/thumb/d/d7/Android_robot.svg/200px-Android_robot.svg.png
— same SVG rendered at 960px, the largest Wikimedia-served size; committed at
tool/logo_source/android_robot_960.png). The Android robot is reproduced from
work created and shared by Google, used according to the Creative Commons 3.0
Attribution License.

The robot is centered on an opaque white square badge (platform icon masks
require an opaque square; the badge keeps Android and iOS consistent), and
all sizes are emitted:

  - assets/images/app_logo.png           (1024x1024 master, in-app)
  - android mipmap ic_launcher.png        (48/72/96/144/192)
  - iOS AppIcon.appiconset PNGs           (all sizes in Contents.json)

Deterministic: no randomness, no network (uses the committed source).
"""
from PIL import Image
import os

MASTER = 1024
ROBOT_HEIGHT_RATIO = 0.68          # robot height as a fraction of the badge
ROOT = os.path.dirname(os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__)))
SOURCE = os.path.join(ROOT, 'tool/logo_source/android_robot_960.png')


def build_master():
    robot = Image.open(SOURCE).convert('RGBA')
    h = round(MASTER * ROBOT_HEIGHT_RATIO)
    w = round(h * robot.width / robot.height)
    robot = robot.resize((w, h), Image.LANCZOS)

    badge = Image.new('RGB', (MASTER, MASTER), (255, 255, 255))
    offset = ((MASTER - w) // 2, (MASTER - h) // 2)
    badge.paste(robot, offset, robot)   # paste with alpha as mask
    return badge


def resample(master, size, path):
    os.makedirs(os.path.dirname(path), exist_ok=True)
    out = master.resize((size, size), Image.LANCZOS)
    out.save(path, 'PNG')
    print(f'wrote {path} ({size}x{size})')


def main():
    master = build_master()

    resample(master, MASTER, os.path.join(ROOT, 'assets/images/app_logo.png'))

    android = [
        ('mipmap-mdpi', 48), ('mipmap-hdpi', 72), ('mipmap-xhdpi', 96),
        ('mipmap-xxhdpi', 144), ('mipmap-xxxhdpi', 192),
    ]
    for density, size in android:
        resample(master, size, os.path.join(
            ROOT, f'android/app/src/main/res/{density}/ic_launcher.png'))

    ios_sizes = [
        ('Icon-App-20x20@1x', 20), ('Icon-App-20x20@2x', 40),
        ('Icon-App-20x20@3x', 60), ('Icon-App-29x29@1x', 29),
        ('Icon-App-29x29@2x', 58), ('Icon-App-29x29@3x', 87),
        ('Icon-App-40x40@1x', 40), ('Icon-App-40x40@2x', 80),
        ('Icon-App-40x40@3x', 120), ('Icon-App-60x60@2x', 120),
        ('Icon-App-60x60@3x', 180), ('Icon-App-76x76@1x', 76),
        ('Icon-App-76x76@2x', 152), ('Icon-App-83.5x83.5@2x', 167),
        ('Icon-App-1024x1024@1x', 1024),
    ]
    for name, size in ios_sizes:
        resample(master, size, os.path.join(
            ROOT, f'ios/Runner/Assets.xcassets/AppIcon.appiconset/{name}.png'))


if __name__ == '__main__':
    main()
","path":"tool/generate_icons.py"}

The safer faithful interpretation: the artwork = Android robot logo; a higher-res render of the identical SVG (same file, same robot, just bigger) serves the intent better (crisp launcher icons at 192px+; the 200px source is barely adequate for xxxhdpi 192 and insufficient for 1024 marketing icon).

Wikipedia thumb URL pattern: replace `200px-` with `1024px-` to get a 1024px render of the same SVG. That's the same file/artwork — I'd argue this is the correct engineering call, and I'll note it in the PR description transparently ("rendered the provided SVG at higher resolution for icon sizes; source artwork unchanged"). Actually wait — let me check whether the thumb renders transparent background: Android robot SVG has transparent background. Launcher icons on Android/iOS generally want a badge/backdrop. If I use the robot directly:
- iOS icons must be opaque square (App Store rejects alpha in marketing icon; runtime icons get masked).

{"content":"#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Generate the DM Tools app logo + all launcher icon sizes.

Source artwork: the Android robot logo, provided by the ticket requester
(https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/thumb/d/d7/Android_robot.svg/200px-Android_robot.svg.png
— same SVG rendered at 960px, the largest Wikimedia-served size; committed at
tool/logo_source/android_robot_960.png). The Android robot is reproduced from
work created and shared by Google, used according to the Creative Commons 3.0
Attribution License.

The robot is centered on an opaque white square badge (platform icon masks
require an opaque square; the badge keeps Android and iOS consistent), and
all sizes are emitted:

  - assets/images/app_logo.png           (1024x1024 master, in-app)
  - android mipmap ic_launcher.png        (48/72/96/144/192)
  - iOS AppIcon.appiconset PNGs           (all sizes in Contents.json)

Deterministic: no randomness, no network (uses the committed source).
"""
from PIL import Image
import os

MASTER = 1024
ROBOT_HEIGHT_RATIO = 0.68          # robot height as a fraction of the badge
ROOT = os.path.dirname(os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__)))
SOURCE = os.path.join(ROOT, 'tool/logo_source/android_robot_960.png')


def build_master():
    robot = Image.open(SOURCE).convert('RGBA')
    h = round(MASTER * ROBOT_HEIGHT_RATIO)
    w = round(h * robot.width / robot.height)
    robot = robot.resize((w, h), Image.LANCZOS)

    badge = Image.new('RGB', (MASTER, MASTER), (255, 255, 255))
    offset = ((MASTER - w) // 2, (MASTER - h) // 2)
    badge.paste(robot, offset, robot)   # paste with alpha as mask
    return badge


def resample(master, size, path):
    os.makedirs(os.path.dirname(path), exist_ok=True)
    out = master.resize((size, size), Image.LANCZOS)
    out.save(path, 'PNG')
    print(f'wrote {path} ({size}x{size})')


def main():
    master = build_master()

    resample(master, MASTER, os.path.join(ROOT, 'assets/images/app_logo.png'))

    android = [
        ('mipmap-mdpi', 48), ('mipmap-hdpi', 72), ('mipmap-xhdpi', 96),
        ('mipmap-xxhdpi', 144), ('mipmap-xxxhdpi', 192),
    ]
    for density, size in android:
        resample(master, size, os.path.join(
            ROOT, f'android/app/src/main/res/{density}/ic_launcher.png'))

    ios_sizes = [
        ('Icon-App-20x20@1x', 20), ('Icon-App-20x20@2x', 40),
        ('Icon-App-20x20@3x', 60), ('Icon-App-29x29@1x', 29),
        ('Icon-App-29x29@2x', 58), ('Icon-App-29x29@3x', 87),
        ('Icon-App-40x40@1x', 40), ('Icon-App-40x40@2x', 80),
        ('Icon-App-40x40@3x', 120), ('Icon-App-60x60@2x', 120),
        ('Icon-App-60x60@3x', 180), ('Icon-App-76x76@1x', 76),
        ('Icon-App-76x76@2x', 152), ('Icon-App-83.5x83.5@2x', 167),
        ('Icon-App-1024x1024@1x', 1024),
    ]
    for name, size in ios_sizes:
        resample(master, size, os.path.join(
            ROOT, f'ios/Runner/Assets.xcassets/AppIcon.appiconset/{name}.png'))


if __name__ == '__main__':
    main()
","path":"tool/generate_icons.py"}

{"content":"#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Generate the DM Tools app logo + all launcher icon sizes.

Source artwork: the Android robot logo, provided by the ticket requester
(https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/thumb/d/d7/Android_robot.svg/200px-Android_robot.svg.png
— same SVG rendered at 960px, the largest Wikimedia-served size; committed at
tool/logo_source/android_robot_960.png). The Android robot is reproduced from
work created and shared by Google, used according to the Creative Commons 3.0
Attribution License.

The robot is centered on an opaque white square badge (platform icon masks
require an opaque square; the badge keeps Android and iOS consistent), and
all sizes are emitted:

  - assets/images/app_logo.png           (1024x1024 master, in-app)
  - android mipmap ic_launcher.png        (48/72/96/144/192)
  - iOS AppIcon.appiconset PNGs           (all sizes in Contents.json)

Deterministic: no randomness, no network (uses the committed source).
"""
from PIL import Image
import os

MASTER = 1024
ROBOT_HEIGHT_RATIO = 0.68          # robot height as a fraction of the badge
ROOT = os.path.dirname(os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__)))
SOURCE = os.path.join(ROOT, 'tool/logo_source/android_robot_960.png')


def build_master():
    robot = Image.open(SOURCE).convert('RGBA')
    h = round(MASTER * ROBOT_HEIGHT_RATIO)
    w = round(h * robot.width / robot.height)
    robot = robot.resize((w, h), Image.LANCZOS)

    badge = Image.new('RGB', (MASTER, MASTER), (255, 255, 255))
    offset = ((MASTER - w) // 2, (MASTER - h) // 2)
    badge.paste(robot, offset, robot)   # paste with alpha as mask
    return badge


def resample(master, size, path):
    os.makedirs(os.path.dirname(path), exist_ok=True)
    out = master.resize((size, size), Image.LANCZOS)
    out.save(path, 'PNG')
    print(f'wrote {path} ({size}x{size})')


def main():
    master = build_master()

    resample(master, MASTER, os.path.join(ROOT, 'assets/images/app_logo.png'))

    android = [
        ('mipmap-mdpi', 48), ('mipmap-hdpi', 72), ('mipmap-xhdpi', 96),
        ('mipmap-xxhdpi', 144), ('mipmap-xxxhdpi', 192),
    ]
    for density, size in android:
        resample(master, size, os.path.join(
            ROOT, f'android/app/src/main/res/{density}/ic_launcher.png'))

    ios_sizes = [
        ('Icon-App-20x20@1x', 20), ('Icon-App-20x20@2x', 40),
        ('Icon-App-20x20@3x', 60), ('Icon-App-29x29@1x', 29),
        ('Icon-App-29x29@2x', 58), ('Icon-App-29x29@3x', 87),
        ('Icon-App-40x40@1x', 40), ('Icon-App-40x40@2x', 80),
        ('Icon-App-40x40@3x', 120), ('Icon-App-60x60@2x', 120),
        ('Icon-App-60x60@3x', 180), ('Icon-App-76x76@1x', 76),
        ('Icon-App-76x76@2x', 152), ('Icon-App-83.5x83.5@2x', 167),
        ('Icon-App-1024x1024@1x', 1024),
    ]
    for name, size in ios_sizes:
        resample(master, size, os.path.join(
            ROOT, f'ios/Runner/Assets.xcassets/AppIcon.appiconset/{name}.png'))


if __name__ == '__main__':
    main()

{"content":"#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Generate the DM Tools app logo + all launcher icon sizes.

Source artwork: the Android robot logo, provided by the ticket requester
(https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/thumb/d/d7/Android_robot.svg/200px-Android_robot.svg.png
— same SVG rendered at 960px, the largest Wikimedia-served size; committed at
tool/logo_source/android_robot_960.png). The Android robot is reproduced from
work created and shared by Google, used according to the Creative Commons 3.0
Attribution License.

The robot is centered on an opaque white square badge (platform icon masks
require an opaque square; the badge keeps Android and iOS consistent), and
all sizes are emitted:

  - assets/images/app_logo.png           (1024x1024 master, in-app)
  - android mipmap ic_launcher.png        (48/72/96/144/192)
  - iOS AppIcon.appiconset PNGs           (all sizes in Contents.json)

Deterministic: no randomness, no network (uses the committed source).
"""
from PIL import Image
import os

MASTER = 1024
ROBOT_HEIGHT_RATIO = 0.68          # robot height as a fraction of the badge
ROOT = os.path.dirname(os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__)))
SOURCE = os.path.join(ROOT, 'tool/logo_source/android_robot_960.png')


def build_master():
    robot = Image.open(SOURCE).convert('RGBA')
    h = round(MASTER * ROBOT_HEIGHT_RATIO)
    w = round(h * robot.width / robot.height)
    robot = robot.resize((w, h), Image.LANCZOS)

    badge = Image.new('RGB', (MASTER, MASTER), (255, 255, 255))
    offset = ((MASTER - w) // 2, (MASTER - h) // 2)
    badge.paste(robot, offset, robot)   # paste with alpha as mask
    return badge


def resample(master, size, path):
    os.makedirs(os.path.dirname(path), exist_ok=True)
    out = master.resize((size, size), Image.LANCZOS)
    out.save(path, 'PNG')
    print(f'wrote {path} ({size}x{size})')


def main():
    master = build_master()

    resample(master, MASTER, os.path.join(ROOT, 'assets/images/app_logo.png'))

    android = [
        ('mipmap-mdpi', 48), ('mipmap-hdpi', 72), ('mipmap-xhdpi', 96),
        ('mipmap-xxhdpi', 144), ('mipmap-xxxhdpi', 192),
    ]
    for density, size in android:
        resample(master, size, os.path.join(
            ROOT, f'android/app/src/main/res/{density}/ic_launcher.png'))

    ios_sizes = [
        ('Icon-App-20x20@1x', 20), ('Icon-App-20x20@2x', 40),
        ('Icon-App-20x20@3x', 60), ('Icon-App-29x29@1x', 29),
        ('Icon-App-29x29@2x', 58), ('Icon-App-29x29@3x', 87),
        ('Icon-App-40x40@1x', 40), ('Icon-App-40x40@2x', 80),
        ('Icon-App-40x40@3x', 120), ('Icon-App-60x60@2x', 120),
        ('Icon-App-60x60@3x', 180), ('Icon-App-76x76@1x', 76),
        ('Icon-App-76x76@2x', 152), ('Icon-App-83.5x83.5@2x', 167),
        ('Icon-App-1024x1024@1x', 1024),
    ]
    for name, size in ios_sizes:
        resample(master, size, os.path.join(
            ROOT, f'ios/Runner/Assets.xcassets/AppIcon.appiconset/{name}.png'))


if __name__ == '__main__':
    main()
","path":"tool/generate_icons.py"}

{"content":"#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Generate the DM Tools app logo + all launcher icon sizes.

Source artwork: the Android robot logo, provided by the ticket requester
(https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/thumb/d/d7/Android_robot.svg/200px-Android_robot.svg.png
— same SVG rendered at 960px, the largest Wikimedia-served size; committed at
tool/logo_source/android_robot_960.png). The Android robot is reproduced from
work created and shared by Google, used according to the Creative Commons 3.0
Attribution License.

The robot is centered on an opaque white square badge (platform icon masks
require an opaque square; the badge keeps Android and iOS consistent), and
all sizes are emitted:

  - assets/images/app_logo.png           (1024x1024 master, in-app)
  - android mipmap ic_launcher.png        (48/72/96/144/192)
  - iOS AppIcon.appiconset PNGs           (all sizes in Contents.json)

Deterministic: no randomness, no network (uses the committed source).
"""
from PIL import Image
import os

MASTER = 1024
ROBOT_HEIGHT_RATIO = 0.68          # robot height as a fraction of the badge
ROOT = os.path.dirname(os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__)))
SOURCE = os.path.join(ROOT, 'tool/logo_source/android_robot_960.png')


def build_master():
    robot = Image.open(SOURCE).convert('RGBA')
    h = round(MASTER * ROBOT_HEIGHT_RATIO)
    w = round(h * robot.width / robot.height)
    robot = robot.resize((w, h), Image.LANCZOS)

    badge = Image.new('RGB', (MASTER, MASTER), (255, 255, 255))
    offset = ((MASTER - w) // 2, (MASTER - h) // 2)
    badge.paste(robot, offset, robot)   # paste with alpha as mask
    return badge


def resample(master, size, path):
    os.makedirs(os.path.dirname(path), exist_ok=True)
    out = master.resize((size, size), Image.LANCZOS)
    out.save(path, 'PNG')
    print(f'wrote {path} ({size}x{size})')


def main():
    master = build_master()

    resample(master, MASTER, os.path.join(ROOT, 'assets/images/app_logo.png'))

    android = [
        ('mipmap-mdpi', 48), ('mipmap-hdpi', 72), ('mipmap-xhdpi', 96),
        ('mipmap-xxhdpi', 144), ('mipmap-xxxhdpi', 192),
    ]
    for density, size in android:
        resample(master, size, os.path.join(
            ROOT, f'android/app/src/main/res/{density}/ic_launcher.png'))

    ios_sizes = [
        ('Icon-App-20x20@1x', 20), ('Icon-App-20x20@2x', 40),
        ('Icon-App-20x20@3x', 60), ('Icon-App-29x29@1x', 29),
        ('Icon-App-29x29@2x', 58), ('Icon-App-29x29@3x', 87),
        ('Icon-App-40x40@1x', 40), ('Icon-App-40x40@2x', 80),
        ('Icon-App-40x40@3x', 120), ('Icon-App-60x60@2x', 120),
        ('Icon-App-60x60@3x', 180), ('Icon-App-76x76@1x', 76),
        ('Icon-App-76x76@2x', 152), ('Icon-App-83.5x83.5@2x', 167),
        ('Icon-App-1024x1024@1x', 1024),
    ]
    for name, size in ios_sizes:
        resample(master, size, os.path.join(
            ROOT, f'ios/Runner/Assets.xcassets/AppIcon.appiconset/{name}.png'))


if __name__ == '__main__':
    main()
","path":"tool/generate_icons.py"}

{"content":"#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Generate the DM Tools app logo + all launcher icon sizes.

Source artwork: the Android robot logo, provided by the ticket requester
(https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/thumb/d/d7/Android_robot.svg/200px-Android_robot.svg.png
— same SVG rendered at 960px, the largest Wikimedia-served size; committed at
tool/logo_source/android_robot_960.png). The Android robot is reproduced from
work created and shared by Google, used according to the Creative Commons 3.0
Attribution License.

The robot is centered on an opaque white square badge (platform icon masks
require an opaque square; the badge keeps Android and iOS consistent), and
all sizes are emitted:

  - assets/images/app_logo.png           (1024x1024 master, in-app)
  - android mipmap ic_launcher.png        (48/72/96/144/192)
  - iOS AppIcon.appiconset PNGs           (all sizes in Contents.json)

Deterministic: no randomness, no network (uses the committed source).
"""
from PIL import Image
import os

MASTER = 1024
ROBOT_HEIGHT_RATIO = 0.68          # robot height as a fraction of the badge
ROOT = os.path.dirname(os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__)))
SOURCE = os.path.join(ROOT, 'tool/logo_source/android_robot_960.png')


def build_master():
    robot = Image.open(SOURCE).convert('RGBA')
    h = round(MASTER * ROBOT_HEIGHT_RATIO)
    w = round(h * robot.width / robot.height)
    robot = robot.resize((w, h), Image.LANCZOS)

    badge = Image.new('RGB', (MASTER, MASTER), (255, 255, 255))
    offset = ((MASTER - w) // 2, (MASTER - h) // 2)
    badge.paste(robot, offset, robot)   # paste with alpha as mask
    return badge


def resample(master, size, path):
    os.makedirs(os.path.dirname(path), exist_ok=True)
    out = master.resize((size, size), Image.LANCZOS)
    out.save(path, 'PNG')
    print(f'wrote {path} ({size}x{size})')


def main():
    master = build_master()

    resample(master, MASTER, os.path.join(ROOT, 'assets/images/app_logo.png'))

    android = [
        ('mipmap-mdpi', 48), ('mipmap-hdpi', 72), ('mipmap-xhdpi', 96),
        ('mipmap-xxhdpi', 144), ('mipmap-xxxhdpi', 192),
    ]
    for density, size in android:
        resample(master, size, os.path.join(
            ROOT, f'android/app/src/main/res/{density}/ic_launcher.png'))

    ios_sizes = [
        ('Icon-App-20x20@1x', 20), ('Icon-App-20x20@2x', 40),
        ('Icon-App-20x20@3x', 60), ('Icon-App-29x29@1x', 29),
        ('Icon-App-29x29@2x', 58), ('Icon-App-29x29@3x', 87),
        ('Icon-App-40x40@1x', 40), ('Icon-App-40x40@2x', 80),
        ('Icon-App-40x40@3x', 120), ('Icon-App-60x60@2x', 120),
        ('Icon-App-60x60@3x', 180), ('Icon-App-76x76@1x', 76),
        ('Icon-App-76x76@2x', 152), ('Icon-App-83.5x83.5@2x', 167),
        ('Icon-App-1024x1024@1x', 1024),
    ]
    for name, size in ios_sizes:
        resample(master, size, os.path.join(
            ROOT, f'ios/Runner/Assets.xcassets/AppIcon.appiconset/{name}.png'))


if __name__ == '__main__':
    main()
","path":"tool/generate_icons.py"}

{"content":"#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Generate the DM Tools app logo + all launcher icon sizes.

Source artwork: the Android robot logo, provided by the ticket requester
(https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/thumb/d/d7/Android_robot.svg/200px-Android_robot.svg.png
— same SVG rendered at 960px, the largest Wikimedia-served size; committed at
tool/logo_source/android_robot_960.png). The Android robot is reproduced from
work created and shared by Google, used according to the Creative Commons 3.0
Attribution License.

The robot is centered on an opaque white square badge (platform icon masks
require an opaque square; the badge keeps Android and iOS consistent), and
all sizes are emitted:

  - assets/images/app_logo.png           (1024x1024 master, in-app)
  - android mipmap ic_launcher.png        (48/72/96/144/192)
  - iOS AppIcon.appiconset PNGs           (all sizes in Contents.json)

Deterministic: no randomness, no network (uses the committed source).
"""
from PIL import Image
import os

MASTER = 1024
ROBOT_HEIGHT_RATIO = 0.68          # robot height as a fraction of the badge
ROOT = os.path.dirname(os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__)))
SOURCE = os.path.join(ROOT, 'tool/logo_source/android_robot_960.png')


def build_master():
    robot = Image.open(SOURCE).convert('RGBA')
    h = round(MASTER * ROBOT_HEIGHT_RATIO)
    w = round(h * robot.width / robot.height)
    robot = robot.resize((w, h), Image.LANCZOS)

    badge = Image.new('RGB', (MASTER, MASTER), (255, 255, 255))
    offset = ((MASTER - w) // 2, (MASTER - h) // 2)
    badge.paste(robot, offset, robot)   # paste with alpha as mask
    return badge


def resample(master, size, path):
    os.makedirs(os.path.dirname(path), exist_ok=True)
    out = master.resize((size, size), Image.LANCZOS)
    out.save(path, 'PNG')
    print(f'wrote {path} ({size}x{size})')


def main():
    master = build_master()

    resample(master, MASTER, os.path.join(ROOT, 'assets/images/app_logo.png'))

    android = [
        ('mipmap-mdpi', 48), ('mipmap-hdpi', 72), ('mipmap-xhdpi', 96),
        ('mipmap-xxhdpi', 144), ('mipmap-xxxhdpi', 192),
    ]
    for density, size in android:
        resample(master, size, os.path.join(
            ROOT, f'android/app/src/main/res/{density}/ic_launcher.png'))

    ios_sizes = [
        ('Icon-App-20x20@1x', 20), ('Icon-App-20x20@2x', 40),
        ('Icon-App-20x20@3x', 60), ('Icon-App-29x29@1x', 29),
        ('Icon-App-29x29@2x', 58), ('Icon-App-29x29@3x', 87),
        ('Icon-App-40x40@1x', 40), ('Icon-App-40x40@2x', 80),
        ('Icon-App-40x40@3x', 120), ('Icon-App-60x60@2x', 120),
        ('Icon-App-60x60@3x', 180), ('Icon-App-76x76@1x', 76),
        ('Icon-App-76x76@2x', 152), ('Icon-App-83.5x83.5@2x', 167),
        ('Icon-App-1024x1024@1x', 1024),
    ]
    for name, size in ios_sizes:
        resample(master, size, os.path.join(
            ROOT, f'ios/Runner/Assets.xcassets/AppIcon.appiconset/{name}.png'))


if __name__ == '__main__':
    main()
","path":"tool/generate_icons.py"}

### What changed
Replaced the app logo with the ticket-provided artwork (Android robot, supplied as a URL in issue #7): Android `mipmap` launcher set (5 densities), full iOS `AppIcon.appiconset`, and the in-app logo on the login screen via a new `AppLogo` widget.

{"content":"#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Generate the DM Tools app logo + all launcher icon sizes.

Source artwork: the Android robot logo, provided by the ticket requester
(https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/thumb/d/d7/Android_robot.svg/200px-Android_robot.svg.png
— same SVG rendered at 960px, the largest Wikimedia-served size; committed at
tool/logo_source/android_robot_960.png). The Android robot is reproduced from
work created and shared by Google, used according to the Creative Commons 3.0
Attribution License.

The robot is centered on an opaque white square badge (platform icon masks
require an opaque square; the badge keeps Android and iOS consistent), and
all sizes are emitted:

  - assets/images/app_logo.png           (1024x1024 master, in-app)
  - android mipmap ic_launcher.png        (48/72/96/144/192)
  - iOS AppIcon.appiconset PNGs           (all sizes in Contents.json)

Deterministic: no randomness, no network (uses the committed source).
"""
from PIL import Image
import os

MASTER = 1024
ROBOT_HEIGHT_RATIO = 0.68          # robot height as a fraction of the badge
ROOT = os.path.dirname(os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__)))
SOURCE = os.path.join(ROOT, 'tool/logo_source/android_robot_960.png')


def build_master():
    robot = Image.open(SOURCE).convert('RGBA')
    h = round(MASTER * ROBOT_HEIGHT_RATIO)
    w = round(h * robot.width / robot.height)
    robot = robot.resize((w, h), Image.LANCZOS)

    badge = Image.new('RGB', (MASTER, MASTER), (255, 255, 255))
    offset = ((MASTER - w) // 2, (MASTER - h) // 2)
    badge.paste(robot, offset, robot)   # paste with alpha as mask
    return badge


def resample(master, size, path):
    os.makedirs(os.path.dirname(path), exist_ok=True)
    out = master.resize((size, size), Image.LANCZOS)
    out.save(path, 'PNG')
    print(f'wrote {path} ({size}x{size})')


def main():
    master = build_master()

    resample(master, MASTER, os.path.join(ROOT, 'assets/images/app_logo.png'))

    android = [
        ('mipmap-mdpi', 48), ('mipmap-hdpi', 72), ('mipmap-xhdpi', 96),
        ('mipmap-xxhdpi', 144), ('mipmap-xxxhdpi', 192),
    ]
    for density, size in android:
        resample(master, size, os.path.join(
            ROOT, f'android/app/src/main/res/{density}/ic_launcher.png'))

    ios_sizes = [
        ('Icon-App-20x20@1x', 20), ('Icon-App-20x20@2x', 40),
        ('Icon-App-20x20@3x', 60), ('Icon-App-29x29@1x', 29),
        ('Icon-App-29x29@2x', 58), ('Icon-App-29x29@3x', 87),
        ('Icon-App-40x40@1x', 40), ('Icon-App-40x40@2x', 80),
        ('Icon-App-40x40@3x', 120), ('Icon-App-60x60@2x', 120),
        ('Icon-App-60x60@3x', 180), ('Icon-App-76x76@1x', 76),
        ('Icon-App-76x76@2x', 152), ('Icon-App-83.5x83.5@2x', 167),
        ('Icon-App-1024x1024@1x', 1024),
    ]
    for name, size in ios_sizes:
        resample(master, size, os.path.join(
            ROOT, f'ios/Runner/Assets.xcassets/AppIcon.appiconset/{name}.png'))


if __name__ == '__main__':
    main()
","path":"tool/generate_icons.py"}

Replaced the app logo with the ticket-provided artwork (Android robot, supplied as a URL in issue #7): Android `mipmap` launcher set (5 densities), full iOS `AppIcon.appiconset`, and the in-app logo on the login screen via a new `AppLogo` widget.

```bash
flutter pub get && flutter analyze && flutter test
```

{"content":"#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Generate the DM Tools app logo + all launcher icon sizes.

Source artwork: the Android robot logo, provided by the ticket requester
(https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/thumb/d/d7/Android_robot.svg/200px-Android_robot.svg.png
— same SVG rendered at 960px, the largest Wikimedia-served size; committed at
tool/logo_source/android_robot_960.png). The Android robot is reproduced from
work created and shared by Google, used according to the Creative Commons 3.0
Attribution License.

The robot is centered on an opaque white square badge (platform icon masks
require an opaque square; the badge keeps Android and iOS consistent), and
all sizes are emitted:

  - assets/images/app_logo.png           (1024x1024 master, in-app)
  - android mipmap ic_launcher.png        (48/72/96/144/192)
  - iOS AppIcon.appiconset PNGs           (all sizes in Contents.json)

Deterministic: no randomness, no network (uses the committed source).
"""
from PIL import Image
import os

MASTER = 1024
ROBOT_HEIGHT_RATIO = 0.68          # robot height as a fraction of the badge
ROOT = os.path.dirname(os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__)))
SOURCE = os.path.join(ROOT, 'tool/logo_source/android_robot_960.png')


def build_master():
    robot = Image.open(SOURCE).convert('RGBA')
    h = round(MASTER * ROBOT_HEIGHT_RATIO)
    w = round(h * robot.width / robot.height)
    robot = robot.resize((w, h), Image.LANCZOS)

    badge = Image.new('RGB', (MASTER, MASTER), (255, 255, 255))
    offset = ((MASTER - w) // 2, (MASTER - h) // 2)
    badge.paste(robot, offset, robot)   # paste with alpha as mask
    return badge


def resample(master, size, path):
    os.makedirs(os.path.dirname(path), exist_ok=True)
    out = master.resize((size, size), Image.LANCZOS)
    out.save(path, 'PNG')
    print(f'wrote {path} ({size}x{size})')


def main():
    master = build_master()

    resample(master, MASTER, os.path.join(ROOT, 'assets/images/app_logo.png'))

    android = [
        ('mipmap-mdpi', 48), ('mipmap-hdpi', 72), ('mipmap-xhdpi', 96),
        ('mipmap-xxhdpi', 144), ('mipmap-xxxhdpi', 192),
    ]
    for density, size in android:
        resample(master, size, os.path.join(
            ROOT, f'android/app/src/main/res/{density}/ic_launcher.png'))

    ios_sizes = [
        ('Icon-App-20x20@1x', 20), ('Icon-App-20x20@2x', 40),
        ('Icon-App-20x20@3x', 60), ('Icon-App-29x29@1x', 29),
        ('Icon-App-29x29@2x', 58), ('Icon-App-29x29@3x', 87),
        ('Icon-App-40x40@1x', 40), ('Icon-App-40x40@2x', 80),
        ('Icon-App-40x40@3x', 120), ('Icon-App-60x60@2x', 120),
        ('Icon-App-60x60@3x', 180), ('Icon-App-76x76@1x', 76),
        ('Icon-App-76x76@2x', 152), ('Icon-App-83.5x83.5@2x', 167),
        ('Icon-App-1024x1024@1x', 1024),
    ]
    for name, size in ios_sizes:
        resample(master, size, os.path.join(
            ROOT, f'ios/Runner/Assets.xcassets/AppIcon.appiconset/{name}.png'))


if __name__ == '__main__':
    main()
","path":"tool/generate_icons.py"}

{"content":"### What changed
Replaced the app logo with the ticket-provided artwork (Android robot, supplied as a URL in issue #7): Android `mipmap` launcher set (5 densities), full iOS `AppIcon.appiconset`, and the in-app logo on the login screen via a new `AppLogo` widget.

### Key decisions
- The requester's link points to a 200px thumbnail; Wikimedia only serves fixed sizes for this file, so the **same SVG** was rendered at 960px (largest served size) and committed under `tool/logo_source/` — regeneration is offline-reproducible via `tool/generate_icons.py`.
- Robot centered on an opaque white square badge: iOS requires an opaque square icon and a uniform badge keeps Android/iOS consistent. Robot artwork and colors untouched.
- In-app logo rendered through `AppLogo` (asset path owned by the widget); rounded corners via `ClipRRect` in-app only — launcher icons stay unrounded squares.
- Android robot is reproduced from work created and shared by Google, used according to the Creative Commons 3.0 Attribution License.

### How to verify
```bash
flutter pub get && flutter analyze && flutter test
```
Logo renders on `LoginPage` (`login_app_logo` widget test); asset ships in the bundle (`test/app_logo_asset_test.dart`); `flutter build apk --debug` succeeds with the new icons.

```mermaid
flowchart TD
  SRC[issue #7 artwork URL] --> F[tool/logo_source/android_robot_960.png]
  F --> GEN[tool/generate_icons.py]
  GEN --> A[assets/images/app_logo.png]
  GEN --> AND[Android mipmap ic_launcher x5]
  GEN --> IOS[iOS AppIcon x15]
  A --> W[AppLogo widget] --> L[LoginPage]
```
</details>

{"content":"#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Generate the DM Tools app logo + all launcher icon sizes.

Source artwork: the Android robot logo, provided by the ticket requester
(https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/thumb/d/d7/Android_robot.svg/200px-Android_robot.svg.png
— same SVG rendered at 960px, the largest Wikimedia-served size; committed at
tool/logo_source/android_robot_960.png). The Android robot is reproduced from
work created and shared by Google, used according to the Creative Commons 3.0
Attribution License.

The robot is centered on an opaque white square badge (platform icon masks
require an opaque square; the badge keeps Android and iOS consistent), and
all sizes are emitted:

  - assets/images/app_logo.png           (1024x1024 master, in-app)
  - android mipmap ic_launcher.png        (48/72/96/144/192)
  - iOS AppIcon.appiconset PNGs           (all sizes in Contents.json)

Deterministic: no randomness, no network (uses the committed source).
"""
from PIL import Image
import os

MASTER = 1024
ROBOT_HEIGHT_RATIO = 0.68          # robot height as a fraction of the badge
ROOT = os.path.dirname(os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__)))
SOURCE = os.path.join(ROOT, 'tool/logo_source/android_robot_960.png')


def build_master():
    robot = Image.open(SOURCE).convert('RGBA')
    h = round(MASTER * ROBOT_HEIGHT_RATIO)
    w = round(h * robot.width / robot.height)
    robot = robot.resize((w, h), Image.LANCZOS)

    badge = Image.new('RGB', (MASTER, MASTER), (255, 255, 255))
    offset = ((MASTER - w) // 2, (MASTER - h) // 2)
    badge.paste(robot, offset, robot)   # paste with alpha as mask
    return badge


def resample(master, size, path):
    os.makedirs(os.path.dirname(path), exist_ok=True)
    out = master.resize((size, size), Image.LANCZOS)
    out.save(path, 'PNG')
    print(f'wrote {path} ({size}x{size})')


def main():
    master = build_master()

    resample(master, MASTER, os.path.join(ROOT, 'assets/images/app_logo.png'))

    android = [
        ('mipmap-mdpi', 48), ('mipmap-hdpi', 72), ('mipmap-xhdpi', 96),
        ('mipmap-xxhdpi', 144), ('mipmap-xxxhdpi', 192),
    ]
    for density, size in android:
        resample(master, size, os.path.join(
            ROOT, f'android/app/src/main/res/{density}/ic_launcher.png'))

    ios_sizes = [
        ('Icon-App-20x20@1x', 20), ('Icon-App-20x20@2x', 40),
        ('Icon-App-20x20@3x', 60), ('Icon-App-29x29@1x', 29),
        ('Icon-App-29x29@2x', 58), ('Icon-App-29x29@3x', 87),
        ('Icon-App-40x40@1x', 40), ('Icon-App-40x40@2x', 80),
        ('Icon-App-40x40@3x', 120), ('Icon-App-60x60@2x', 120),
        ('Icon-App-60x60@3x', 180), ('Icon-App-76x76@1x', 76),
        ('Icon-App-76x76@2x', 152), ('Icon-App-83.5x83.5@2x', 167),
        ('Icon-App-1024x1024@1x', 1024),
    ]
    for name, size in ios_sizes:
        resample(master, size, os.path.join(
            ROOT, f'ios/Runner/Assets.xcassets/AppIcon.appiconset/{name}.png'))


if __name__ == '__main__':
    main()
","path":"tool/generate_icons.py"}

{"content":"#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Generate the DM Tools app logo + all launcher icon sizes.

Source artwork: the Android robot logo, provided by the ticket requester
(https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/thumb/d/d7/Android_robot.svg/200px-Android_robot.svg.png
— same SVG rendered at 960px, the largest Wikimedia-served size; committed at
tool/logo_source/android_robot_960.png). The Android robot is reproduced from
work created and shared by Google, used according to the Creative Commons 3.0
Attribution License.

The robot is centered on an opaque white square badge (platform icon masks
require an opaque square; the badge keeps Android and iOS consistent), and
all sizes are emitted:

  - assets/images/app_logo.png           (1024x1024 master, in-app)
  - android mipmap ic_launcher.png        (48/72/96/144/192)
  - iOS AppIcon.appiconset PNGs           (all sizes in Contents.json)

Deterministic: no randomness, no network (uses the committed source).
"""
from PIL import Image
import os

MASTER = 1024
ROBOT_HEIGHT_RATIO = 0.68          # robot height as a fraction of the badge
ROOT = os.path.dirname(os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__)))
SOURCE = os.path.join(ROOT, 'tool/logo_source/android_robot_960.png')


def build_master():
    robot = Image.open(SOURCE).convert('RGBA')
    h = round(MASTER * ROBOT_HEIGHT_RATIO)
    w = round(h * robot.width / robot.height)
    robot = robot.resize((w, h), Image.LANCZOS)

    badge = Image.new('RGB', (MASTER, MASTER), (255, 255, 255))
    offset = ((MASTER - w) // 2, (MASTER - h) // 2)
    badge.paste(robot, offset, robot)   # paste with alpha as mask
    return badge


def resample(master, size, path):
    os.makedirs(os.path.dirname(path), exist_ok=True)
    out = master.resize((size, size), Image.LANCZOS)
    out.save(path, 'PNG')
    print(f'wrote {path} ({size}x{size})')


def main():
    master = build_master()

    resample(master, MASTER, os.path.join(ROOT, 'assets/images/app_logo.png'))

    android = [
        ('mipmap-mdpi', 48), ('mipmap-hdpi', 72), ('mipmap-xhdpi', 96),
        ('mipmap-xxhdpi', 144), ('mipmap-xxxhdpi', 192),
    ]
    for density, size in android:
        resample(master, size, os.path.join(
            ROOT, f'android/app/src/main/res/{density}/ic_launcher.png'))

    ios_sizes = [
        ('Icon-App-20x20@1x', 20), ('Icon-App-20x20@2x', 40),
        ('Icon-App-20x20@3x', 60), ('Icon-App-29x29@1x', 29),
        ('Icon-App-29x29@2x', 58), ('Icon-App-29x29@3x', 87),
        ('Icon-App-40x40@1x', 40), ('Icon-App-40x40@2x', 80),
        ('Icon-App-40x40@3x', 120), ('Icon-App-60x60@2x', 120),
        ('Icon-App-60x60@3x', 180), ('Icon-App-76x76@1x', 76),
        ('Icon-App-76x76@2x', 152), ('Icon-App-83.5x83.5@2x', 167),
        ('Icon-App-1024x1024@1x', 1024),
    ]
    for name, size in ios_sizes:
        resample(master, size, os.path.join(
            ROOT, f'ios/Runner/Assets.xcassets/AppIcon.appiconset/{name}.png'))


if __name__ == '__main__':
    main()
","path":"tool/generate_icons.py"}

{"content":"### What changed
Replaced the app logo with the ticket-provided artwork (Android robot, supplied as a URL in issue #7): Android `mipmap` launcher set (5 densities), full iOS `AppIcon.appiconset`, and the in-app logo on the login screen via a new `AppLogo` widget.

### Key decisions
- The requester's link points to a 200px thumbnail; Wikimedia only serves fixed sizes for this file, so the **same SVG** was rendered at 960px (largest served size) and committed under `tool/logo_source/` — regeneration is offline-reproducible via `tool/generate_icons.py`.
- Robot centered on an opaque white square badge: iOS requires an opaque square icon and a uniform badge keeps Android/iOS consistent. Robot artwork and colors untouched.
- In-app logo rendered through `AppLogo` (asset path owned by the widget); rounded corners via `ClipRRect` in-app only — launcher icons stay unrounded squares.
- Android robot is reproduced from work created and shared by Google, used according to the Creative Commons 3.0 Attribution License.

### How to verify
```bash
flutter pub get && flutter analyze && flutter test
```
Logo renders on `LoginPage` (`login_app_logo` widget test); asset ships in the bundle (`test/app_logo_asset_test.dart`); `flutter build apk --debug` succeeds with the new icons.

```mermaid
  GEN --> AND[Android mipmap ic_launcher x5]

```

{"content":"#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Generate the DM Tools app logo + all launcher icon sizes.

Source artwork: the Android robot logo, provided by the ticket requester
(https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/thumb/d/d7/Android_robot.svg/200px-Android_robot.svg.png
— same SVG rendered at 960px, the largest Wikimedia-served size; committed at
tool/logo_source/android_robot_960.png). The Android robot is reproduced from
work created and shared by Google, used according to the Creative Commons 3.0
Attribution License.

The robot is centered on an opaque white square badge (platform icon masks
require an opaque square; the badge keeps Android and iOS consistent), and
all sizes are emitted:

  - assets/images/app_logo.png           (1024x1024 master, in-app)
  - android mipmap ic_launcher.png        (48/72/96/144/192)
  - iOS AppIcon.appiconset PNGs           (all sizes in Contents.json)

Deterministic: no randomness, no network (uses the committed source).
"""
from PIL import Image
import os

MASTER = 1024
ROBOT_HEIGHT_RATIO = 0.68          # robot height as a fraction of the badge
ROOT = os.path.dirname(os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__)))
SOURCE = os.path.join(ROOT, 'tool/logo_source/android_robot_960.png')


def build_master():
    robot = Image.open(SOURCE).convert('RGBA')
    h = round(MASTER * ROBOT_HEIGHT_RATIO)
    w = round(h * robot.width / robot.height)
    robot = robot.resize((w, h), Image.LANCZOS)

    badge = Image.new('RGB', (MASTER, MASTER), (255, 255, 255))
    offset = ((MASTER - w) // 2, (MASTER - h) // 2)
    badge.paste(robot, offset, robot)   # paste with alpha as mask
    return badge


def resample(master, size, path):
    os.makedirs(os.path.dirname(path), exist_ok=True)
    out = master.resize((size, size), Image.LANCZOS)
    out.save(path, 'PNG')
    print(f'wrote {path} ({size}x{size})')


def main():
    master = build_master()

    resample(master, MASTER, os.path.join(ROOT, 'assets/images/app_logo.png'))

    android = [

    ]

        resample(master, size, os.path.join(

{"content":"### What changed
Replaced the app logo with the ticket-provided artwork (Android robot, supplied as a URL in issue #7): Android `mipmap` launcher set (5 densities), full iOS `AppIcon.appiconset`, and the in-app logo on the login screen via a new `AppLogo` widget.

### Key decisions
- The requester's link points to a 200px thumbnail; Wikimedia only serves fixed sizes for this file, so the **same SVG** was rendered at 960px (largest served size) and committed under `tool/logo_source/` — regeneration is offline-reproducible via `tool/generate_icons.py`.
- Robot centered on an opaque white square badge: iOS requires an opaque square icon and a uniform badge keeps Android/iOS consistent. Robot artwork and colors untouched.
- In-app logo rendered through `AppLogo` (asset path owned by the widget); rounded corners via `ClipRRect` in-app only — launcher icons stay unrounded squares.
- Android robot is reproduced from work created and shared by Google, used according to the Creative Commons 3.0 Attribution License.

### How to verify
```bash
flutter pub get && flutter analyze && flutter test
```
Logo renders on `LoginPage` (`login_app_logo` widget test); asset ships in the bundle (`test/app_logo_asset_test.dart`); `flutter build apk --debug` succeeds with the new icons.

{"content":"#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Generate the DM Tools app logo + all launcher icon sizes.

Source artwork: the Android robot logo, provided by the ticket requester
(https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/thumb/d/d7/Android_robot.svg/200px-Android_robot.svg.png
— same SVG rendered at 960px, the largest Wikimedia-served size; committed at
tool/logo_source/android_robot_960.png). The Android robot is reproduced from
work created and shared by Google, used according to the Creative Commons 3.0
Attribution License.

The robot is centered on an opaque white square badge (platform icon masks
require an opaque square; the badge keeps Android and iOS consistent), and
all sizes are emitted:

  - assets/images/app_logo.png           (1024x1024 master, in-app)
  - android mipmap ic_launcher.png        (48/72/96/144/192)
  - iOS AppIcon.appiconset PNGs           (all sizes in Contents.json)

Deterministic: no randomness, no network (uses the committed source).
"""
from PIL import Image
import os

MASTER = 1024
ROBOT_HEIGHT_RATIO = 0.68          # robot height as a fraction of the badge
ROOT = os.path.dirname(os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__)))
SOURCE = os.path.join(ROOT, 'tool/logo_source/android_robot_960.png')


def build_master():
    robot = Image.open(SOURCE).convert('RGBA')
    h = round(MASTER * ROBOT_HEIGHT_RATIO)
    w = round(h * robot.width / robot.height)
    robot = robot.resize((w, h), Image.LANCZOS)

    badge = Image.new('RGB', (MASTER, MASTER), (255, 255, 255))
    offset = ((MASTER - w) // 2, (MASTER - h) // 2)
    badge.paste(robot, offset, robot)   # paste with alpha as mask
    return badge


def resample(master, size, path):
    os.makedirs(os.path.dirname(path), exist_ok=True)
    out = master.resize((size, size), Image.LANCZOS)
    out.save(path, 'PNG')
    print(f'wrote {path} ({size}x{size})')


def main():
    master = build_master()

    resample(master, MASTER, os.path.join(ROOT, 'assets/images/app_logo.png'))

    android = [
        ('mipmap-mdpi', 48), ('mipmap-hdpi', 72), ('mipmap-xhdpi', 96),
        ('mipmap-xxhdpi', 144), ('mipmap-xxxhdpi', 192),
    ]
    for density, size in android:
        resample(master, size, os.path.join(
            ROOT, f'android/app/src/main/res/{density}/ic_launcher.png'))

    ios_sizes = [
        ('Icon-App-20x20@1x', 20), ('Icon-App-20x20@2x', 40),
        ('Icon-App-20x20@3x', 60), ('Icon-App-29x29@1x', 29),
        ('Icon-App-29x29@2x', 58), ('Icon-App-29x29@3x', 87),
        ('Icon-App-40x40@1x', 40), ('Icon-App-40x40@2x', 80),
        ('Icon-App-40x40@3x', 120), ('Icon-App-60x60@2x', 120),
        ('Icon-App-60x60@3x', 180), ('Icon-App-76x76@1x', 76),
        ('Icon-App-76x76@2x', 152), ('Icon-App-83.5x83.5@2x', 167),
        ('Icon-App-1024x1024@1x', 1024),
    ]
    for name, size in ios_sizes:
        resample(master, size, os.path.join(
            ROOT, f'ios/Runner/Assets.xcassets/AppIcon.appiconset/{name}.png'))


if __name__ == '__main__':
    main()
","path":"tool/generate_icons.py"}

{"content":"### What changed
Replaced the app logo with the ticket-provided artwork (Android robot, supplied as a URL in issue #7): Android `mipmap` launcher set (5 densities), full iOS `AppIcon.appiconset`, and the in-app logo on the login screen via a new `AppLogo` widget.

### Key decisions
- The requester's link points to a 200px thumbnail; Wikimedia only serves fixed sizes for this file, so the **same SVG** was rendered at 960px (largest served size) and committed under `tool/logo_source/` — regeneration is offline-reproducible via `tool/generate_icons.py`.
- Robot centered on an opaque white square badge: iOS requires an opaque square icon and a uniform badge keeps Android/iOS consistent. Robot artwork and colors untouched.
- In-app logo rendered through `AppLogo` (asset path owned by the widget); rounded corners via `ClipRRect` in-app only — launcher icons stay unrounded squares.
- Android robot is reproduced from work created and shared by Google, used according to the Creative Commons 3.0 Attribution License.


blocks.text:
A human reply arrived: "Apologies — attaching the logo now. Use this one: https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/thumb/d7/Android_robot.svg/200px-Android_robot.svg.png"

This is a reply from the repo owner (ajaxspace) — the ticket requester — providing a direct download URL for the logo. This answers my needs-input question. The pre-flight highlight is now RESOLVED: the missing attachment has been supplied as a URL.

Pre-flight is now CLEAN: the ticket references a logo, and the logo source is now present in the ticket context (human comment with URL). Continue with the normal flow:

1. Download the logo from the URL.
2. Inspect it (200px thumb of the Android robot SVG — it's a PNG render, 200px wide; the Android robot is mostly green with transparency).
3. Implement: launcher icons (Android mipmap ×5, iOS AppIcon ×15) + in-app logo on the login screen. Keep app name, colors, layout otherwise unchanged.

Considerations for the artwork:
- The URL is a 200px PNG thumbnail of the Android robot SVG. 200px is small for a 1024px master. The ticket AC: "App builds with the new logo", "No other visual changes". The human explicitly said "Use this one" with that URL. I must use THAT artwork, not a substitute. 
- Upscaling 200→1024 will be blurry. Options: (a) use the 200px as-is and upsample with LANCZOS (blury but faithful); (b) fetch a higher-res version of the same artwork from the same source (e.g., the SVG original at commons, or a larger thumb like 1024px). Is fetching a larger render of the SAME file "improvising"? The human said "Use this one: <200px thumb URL>". The artwork is the Android robot. Rendering the same SVG at higher resolution is the same logo, better quality. Hmm — but strictly, the URL they gave is the 200px thumb. The safer faithful interpretation: the artwork = Android robot logo; a higher-res render of the identical SVG (same file, same robot, just bigger) serves the intent better (crisp launcher icons at 192px+; the 200px source is barely adequate for xxxhdpi 192 and insufficient for 1024 marketing icon).

Wikipedia thumb URL pattern: replace `200px-` with `1024px-` to get a 1024px render of the same SVG. That's the same file/artwork — I'd argue this is the correct engineering call, and I'll note it in the PR description transparently ("rendered the provided SVG at higher resolution for icon sizes; source artwork unchanged"). Actually wait — let me check whether the thumb renders transparent background: Android robot SVG has transparent background. Launcher icons on Android/iOS generally want a badge/backdrop. If I use the robot directly:
- iOS icons must be opaque square (App Store rejects alpha in marketing icon; runtime icons get masked).
- Android legacy launcher icons: transparent background is allowed (the robot would float on the launcher background) — that's actually how many icons look, but the DEFAULT Flutter icon is opaque.
- In-app logo: transparent works fine.

{"content":"#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Generate the DM Tools app logo + all launcher icon sizes.

Source artwork: the Android robot logo, provided by the ticket requester
(https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/thumb/d/d7/Android_robot.svg/200px-Android_robot.svg.png
— same SVG rendered at 960px, the largest Wikimedia-served size; committed at
tool/logo_source/android_robot_960.png). The Android robot is reproduced from
work created and shared by Google, used according to the Creative Commons 3.0
Attribution License.

The robot is centered on an opaque white square badge (platform icon masks
require an opaque square; the badge keeps Android and iOS consistent), and
all sizes are emitted:

  - assets/images/app_logo.png           (1024x1024 master, in-app)
  - android mipmap ic_launcher.png        (48/72/96/144/192)
  - iOS AppIcon.appiconset PNGs           (all sizes in Contents.json)

Deterministic: no randomness, no network (uses the committed source).
"""
from PIL import Image
import os

MASTER = 1024
ROBOT_HEIGHT_RATIO = 0.68          # robot height as a fraction of the badge
ROOT = os.path.dirname(os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__)))
SOURCE = os.path.join(ROOT, 'tool/logo_source/android_robot_960.png')


def build_master():
    robot = Image.open(SOURCE).convert('RGBA')
    h = round(MASTER * ROBOT_HEIGHT_RATIO)
    w = round(h * robot.width / robot.height)
    robot = robot.resize((w, h), Image.LANCZOS)

    badge = Image.new('RGB', (MASTER, MASTER), (255, 255, 255))
    offset = ((MASTER - w) // 2, (MASTER - h) // 2)
    badge.paste(robot, offset, robot)   # paste with alpha as mask
    return badge


def resample(master, size, path):
    os.makedirs(os.path.dirname(path), exist_ok=True)
    out = master.resize((size, size), Image.LANCZOS)
    out.save(path, 'PNG')
    print(f'wrote {path} ({size}x{size})')


def main():
    master = build_master()

    resample(master, MASTER, os.path.join(ROOT, 'assets/images/app_logo.png'))

    android = [
        ('mipmap-mdpi', 48), ('mipmap-hdpi', 72), ('mipmap-xhdpi', 96),
        ('mipmap-xxhdpi', 144), ('mipmap-xxxhdpi', 192),
    ]
    for density, size in android:
        resample(master, size, os.path.join(
            ROOT, f'android/app/src/main/res/{density}/ic_launcher.png'))

    ios_sizes = [
        ('Icon-App-20x20@1x', 20), ('Icon-App-20x20@2x', 40),
        ('Icon-App-20x20@3x', 60), ('Icon-App-29x29@1x', 29),
        ('Icon-App-29x29@2x', 58), ('Icon-App-29x29@3x', 87),
        ('Icon-App-40x40@1x', 40), ('Icon-App-40x40@2x', 80),
        ('Icon-App-40x40@3x', 120), ('Icon-App-60x60@2x', 120),
        ('Icon-App-60x60@3x', 180), ('Icon-App-76x76@1x', 76),
        ('Icon-App-76x76@2x', 152), ('Icon-App-83.5x83.5@2x', 167),
        ('Icon-App-1024x1024@1x', 1024),
    ]
    for name, size in ios_sizes:
        resample(master, size, os.path.join(
            ROOT, f'ios/Runner/Assets.xcassets/AppIcon.appiconset/{name}.png'))


if __name__ == '__main__':
    main()
","path":"tool/generate_icons.py"}

{"content":"### What changed
Replaced the app logo with the ticket-provided artwork (Android robot, supplied as a URL in issue #7): Android `mipmap` launcher set (5 densities), full iOS `AppIcon.appiconset`, and the in-app logo on the login screen via a new `AppLogo` widget.

### Key decisions
- The requester's link points to a 200px thumbnail; Wikimedia only serves fixed sizes for this file, so the **same SVG** was rendered at 960px (largest served size) and committed under `tool/logo_source/` — regeneration is offline-reproducible via `tool/generate_icons.py`.
- Robot centered on an opaque white square badge: iOS requires an opaque square icon and a uniform badge keeps Android/iOS consistent. Robot artwork and colors untouched.
- In-app logo rendered through `AppLogo` (asset path owned by the widget); rounded corners via `ClipRRect` in-app only — launcher icons stay unrounded squares.
- Android robot is reproduced from work created and shared by Google, used according to the Creative Commons 3.0 Attribution License.

### How to verify
```bash
flutter pub get && flutter analyze && flutter test
```
Logo renders on `LoginPage` (`login_app_logo` widget test); asset ships in the bundle (`test/app_logo_asset_test.dart`); `flutter build apk --debug` succeeds with the new icons.

<details><summary>Architecture</summary>

```mermaid
flowchart TD
  SRC[issue #7 artwork URL] --> F[tool/logo_source/android_robot_960.png]
  F --> GEN[tool/generate_icons.py]
  GEN --> A[assets/images/app_logo.png]
  GEN --> AND[Android mipmap ic_launcher x5]
  GEN --> IOS[iOS AppIcon x15]
  A --> W[AppLogo widget] --> L[LoginPage]
```
</details>

{"content":"#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Generate the DM Tools app logo + all launcher icon sizes.

Source artwork: the Android robot logo, provided by the ticket requester
(https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/thumb/d/d7/Android_robot.svg/200px-Android_robot.svg.png
— same SVG rendered at 960px, the largest Wikimedia-served size; committed at
tool/logo_source/android_robot_960.png). The Android robot is reproduced from
work created and shared by Google, used according to the Creative Commons 3.0
Attribution License.

The robot is centered on an opaque white square badge (platform icon masks
require an opaque square; the badge keeps Android and iOS consistent), and
all sizes are emitted:

  - assets/images/app_logo.png           (1024x1024 master, in-app)
  - android mipmap ic_launcher.png        (48/72/96/144/192)
  - iOS AppIcon.appiconset PNGs           (all sizes in Contents.json)

Deterministic: no randomness, no network (uses the committed source).
"""
from PIL import Image
import os

MASTER = 1024
ROBOT_HEIGHT_RATIO = 0.68          # robot height as a fraction of the badge
ROOT = os.path.dirname(os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__)))
SOURCE = os.path.join(ROOT, 'tool/logo_source/android_robot_960.png')


def build_master():
    robot = Image.open(SOURCE).convert('RGBA')
    h = round(MASTER * ROBOT_HEIGHT_RATIO)
    w = round(h * robot.width / robot.height)
    robot = robot.resize((w, h), Image.LANCZOS)

    badge = Image.new('RGB', (MASTER, MASTER), (255, 255, 255))
    offset = ((MASTER - w) // 2, (MASTER - h) // 2)
    badge.paste(robot, offset, robot)   # paste with alpha as mask
    return badge


def resample(master, size, path):
    os.makedirs(os.path.dirname(path), exist_ok=True)
    out = master.resize((size, size), Image.LANCZOS)
    out.save(path, 'PNG')
    print(f'wrote {path} ({size}x{size})')


def main():
    master = build_master()

    resample(master, MASTER, os.path.join(ROOT, 'assets/images/app_logo.png'))

    android = [
        ('mipmap-mdpi', 48), ('mipmap-hdpi', 72), ('mipmap-xhdpi', 96),
        ('mipmap-xxhdpi', 144), ('mipmap-xxxhdpi', 192),
    ]
    for density, size in android:
        resample(master, size, os.path.join(
            ROOT, f'android/app/src/main/res/{density}/ic_launcher.png'))

    ios_sizes = [
        ('Icon-App-20x20@1x', 20), ('Icon-App-20x20@2x', 40),
        ('Icon-App-20x20@3x', 60), ('Icon-App-29x29@1x', 29),

        ('Icon-App-1024x1024@1x', 1024),
    ]
    for name, size in ios_sizes:
        resample(master, size, os.path.join(
            ROOT, f'ios/Runner/Assets.xcassets/AppIcon.appiconset/{name}.png'))


if __name__ == '__main__':

{"content":"### What changed
Replaced the app logo with the ticket-provided artwork (Android robot, supplied as a URL in issue #7): Android `mipmap` launcher set (5 densities), full iOS `AppIcon.appiconset`, and the in-app logo on the login screen via a new `AppLogo` widget.

### Key decisions
- The requester's link points to a 200px thumbnail; Wikimedia only serves fixed sizes for this file, so the **same SVG** was rendered at 960px (largest served size) and committed under `tool/logo_source/` — regeneration is offline-reproducible via `tool/generate_icons.py`.
- Robot centered on an opaque white square badge: iOS requires an opaque square icon and a uniform badge keeps Android/iOS consistent. Robot artwork and colors untouched.
- In-app logo rendered through `AppLogo` (asset path owned by the widget); rounded corners via `ClipRRect` in-app only — launcher icons stay unrounded squares.
- Android robot is reproduced from work created and shared by Google, used according to the Creative Commons 3.0 Attribution License.

### How to verify
```bash
flutter pub get && flutter analyze && flutter test
```
Logo renders on `LoginPage` (`login_app_logo` widget test); asset ships in the bundle (`test/app_logo_asset_test.dart`); `flutter build apk --debug` succeeds with the new icons.

```mermaid
flowchart TD

  GEN --> AND[Android mipmap ic_launcher x5]
  GEN --> IOS[iOS AppIcon x15]
  A --> W[AppLogo widget] --> L[LoginPage]
```
</details>

{"content":"#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Generate the DM Tools app logo + all launcher icon sizes.

Source artwork: the Android robot logo, provided by the ticket requester
(https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/thumb/d/d7/Android_robot.svg/200px-Android_robot.svg.png
— same SVG rendered at 960px, the largest Wikimedia-served size; committed at
tool/logo_source/android_robot_960.png). The Android robot is reproduced from
work created and shared by Google, used according to the Creative Commons 3.0
Attribution License.

The robot is centered on an opaque white square badge (platform icon masks
require an opaque square; the badge keeps Android and iOS consistent), and
all sizes are emitted:

  - assets/images/app_logo.png           (1024x1024 master, in-app)
  - android mipmap ic_launcher.png        (48/72/96/144/192)
  - iOS AppIcon.appiconset PNGs           (all sizes in Contents.json)

Deterministic: no randomness, no network (uses the committed source).
"""
from PIL import Image
import os

MASTER = 1024
ROBOT_HEIGHT_RATIO = 0.68          # robot height as a fraction of the badge
ROOT = os.path.dirname(os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__)))
SOURCE = os.path.join(ROOT, 'tool/logo_source/android_robot_960.png')


def build_master():
    robot = Image.open(SOURCE).convert('RGBA')
    h = round(MASTER * ROBOT_HEIGHT_RATIO)
    w = round(h * robot.width / robot.height)
    robot = robot.resize((w, h), Image.LANCZOS)

    badge = Image.new('RGB', (MASTER, MASTER), (255, 255, 255))
    offset = ((MASTER - w) // 2, (MASTER - h) // 2)
    badge.paste(robot, offset, robot)   # paste with alpha as mask
    return badge


def resample(master, size, path):
    os.makedirs(os.path.dirname(path), exist_ok=True)
    out = master.resize((size, size), Image.LANCZOS)
    out.save(path, 'PNG')
    print(f'wrote {path} ({size}x{size})')


def main():
    master = build_master()

    resample(master, MASTER, os.path.join(ROOT, 'assets/images/app_logo.png'))

    android = [
        ('mipmap-mdpi', 48), ('mipmap-hdpi', 72), ('mipmap-xhdpi', 96),
        ('mipmap-xxhdpi', 144), ('mipmap-xxxhdpi', 192),
    ]
    for density, size in android:
        resample(master, size, os.path.join(
            ROOT, f'android/app/src/main/res/{density}/ic_launcher.png'))

    ios_sizes = [
        ('Icon-App-20x20@1x', 20), ('Icon-App-20x20@2x', 40),
        ('Icon-App-20x20@3x', 60), ('Icon-App-29x29@1x', 29),
        ('Icon-App-29x29@2x', 58), ('Icon-App-29x29@3x', 87),
        ('Icon-App-40x40@1x', 40), ('Icon-App-40x40@2x', 80),
        ('Icon-App-40x40@3x', 120), ('Icon-App-60x60@2x', 120),
        ('Icon-App-60x60@3x', 180), ('Icon-App-76x76@1x', 76),
        ('Icon-App-76x76@2x', 152), ('Icon-App-83.5x83.5@2x', 167),
        ('Icon-App-1024x1024@1x', 1024),
    ]
    for name, size in ios_sizes:
        resample(master, size, os.path.join(
            ROOT, f'ios/Runner/Assets.xcassets/AppIcon.appiconset/{name}.png'))


if __name__ == '__main__':
    main()
","path":"tool/generate_icons.py"}

{"content":"### What changed
Replaced the app logo with the ticket-provided artwork (Android robot, supplied as a URL in issue #7): Android `mipmap` launcher set (5 densities), full iOS `AppIcon.appiconset`, and the in-app logo on the login screen via a new `AppLogo` widget.

### Key decisions
- The requester's link points to a 200px thumbnail; Wikimedia only serves fixed sizes for this file, so the **same SVG** was rendered at 960px (largest served size) and committed under `tool/logo_source/` — regeneration is offline-reproducible via `tool/generate_icons.py`.
- Robot centered on an opaque white square badge: iOS requires an opaque square icon and a uniform badge keeps Android/iOS consistent. Robot artwork and colors untouched.
- In-app logo rendered through `AppLogo` (asset path owned by the widget); rounded corners via `ClipRRect` in-app only — launcher icons stay unrounded squares.
- Android robot is reproduced from work created and shared by Google, used according to the Creative Commons 3.0 Attribution License.

### How to verify
```bash
flutter pub get && flutter analyze && flutter test
```
Logo renders on `LoginPage` (`login_app_logo` widget test); asset ships in the bundle (`test/app_logo_asset_test.dart`); `flutter build apk --debug` succeeds with the new icons.

<details><summary>Architecture</summary>

```mermaid
flowchart TD
  SRC[issue #7 artwork URL] --> F[tool/logo_source/android_robot_960.png]
  F --> GEN[tool/generate_icons.py]
  GEN --> A[assets/images/app_logo.png]
  GEN --> AND[Android mipmap ic_launcher x5]
  GEN --> IOS[iOS AppIcon x15]
  A --> W[AppLogo widget] --> L[LoginPage]
```
</details>
","path":"outputs/response.md"}

{"content":"#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Generate the DM Tools app logo + all launcher icon sizes.

Source artwork: the Android robot logo, provided by the ticket requester
(https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/thumb/d/d7/Android_robot.svg/200px-Android_robot.svg.png
— same SVG rendered at 960px, the largest Wikimedia-served size; committed at
tool/logo_source/android_robot_960.png). The Android robot is reproduced from
work created and shared by Google, used according to the Creative Commons 3.0
Attribution License.

The robot is centered on an opaque white square badge (platform icon masks
require an opaque square; the badge keeps Android and iOS consistent), and
all sizes are emitted:

  - assets/images/app_logo.png           (1024x1024 master, in-app)
  - android mipmap ic_launcher.png        (48/72/96/144/192)
  - iOS AppIcon.appiconset PNGs           (all sizes in Contents.json)

Deterministic: no randomness, no network (uses the committed source).
"""
from PIL import Image
import os

MASTER = 1024
ROBOT_HEIGHT_RATIO = 0.68          # robot height as a fraction of the badge
ROOT = os.path.dirname(os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__)))
SOURCE = os.path.join(ROOT, 'tool/logo_source/android_robot_960.png')


def build_master():
    robot = Image.open(SOURCE).convert('RGBA')
    h = round(MASTER * ROBOT_HEIGHT_RATIO)
    w = round(h * robot.width / robot.height)
    robot = robot.resize((w, h), Image.LANCZOS)

    badge = Image.new('RGB', (MASTER, MASTER), (255, 255, 255))
    offset = ((MASTER - w) // 2, (MASTER - h) // 2)
    badge.paste(robot, offset, robot)   # paste with alpha as mask
    return badge


def resample(master, size, path):
    os.makedirs(os.path.dirname(path), exist_ok=True)
    out = master.resize((size, size), Image.LANCZOS)
    out.save(path, 'PNG')
    print(f'wrote {path} ({size}x{size})')


def main():
    master = build_master()

    resample(master, MASTER, os.path.join(ROOT, 'assets/images/app_logo.png'))

    android = [
        ('mipmap-mdpi', 48), ('mipmap-hdpi', 72), ('mipmap-xhdpi', 96),
        ('mipmap-xxhdpi', 144), ('mipmap-xxxhdpi', 192),
    ]
    for density, size in android:
        resample(master, size, os.path.join(
            ROOT, f'android/app/src/main/res/{density}/ic_launcher.png'))

    ios_sizes = [
        ('Icon-App-20x20@1x', 20), ('Icon-App-20x20@2x', 40),
        ('Icon-App-20x20@3x', 60), ('Icon-App-29x29@1x', 29),
        ('Icon-App-29x29@2x', 58), ('Icon-App-29x29@3x', 87),
        ('Icon-App-40x40@1x', 40), ('Icon-App-40x40@2x', 80),
        ('Icon-App-40x40@3x', 120), ('Icon-App-60x60@2x', 120),
        ('Icon-App-60x60@3x', 180), ('Icon-App-76x76@1x', 76),
        ('Icon-App-76x76@2x', 152), ('Icon-App-83.5x83.5@2x', 167),
        ('Icon-App-1024x1024@1x', 1024),
    ]
    for name, size in ios_sizes:
        resample(master, size, os.path.join(
            ROOT, f'ios/Runner/Assets.xcassets/AppIcon.appiconset/{name}.png'))


if __name__ == '__main__':
    main()
","path":"tool/generate_icons.py"}

{"content":"### What changed
Replaced the app logo with the ticket-provided artwork (Android robot, supplied as a URL in issue #7): Android `mipmap` launcher set (5 densities), full iOS `AppIcon.appiconset`, and the in-app logo on the login screen via a new `AppLogo` widget.

### Key decisions
- The requester's link points to a 200px thumbnail; Wikimedia only serves fixed sizes for this file, so the **same SVG** was rendered at 960px (largest served size) and committed under `tool/logo_source/` — regeneration is offline-reproducible via `tool/generate_icons.py`.
- Robot centered on an opaque white square badge: iOS requires an opaque square icon and a uniform badge keeps Android/iOS consistent. Robot artwork and colors untouched.
- In-app logo rendered through `AppLogo` (asset path owned by the widget); rounded corners via `ClipRRect` in-app only — launcher icons stay unrounded squares.
- Android robot is reproduced from work created and shared by Google, used according to the Creative Commons 3.0 Attribution License.

### How to verify
```bash
flutter pub get && flutter analyze && flutter test
```
Logo renders on `LoginPage` (`login_app_logo` widget test); asset ships in the bundle (`test/app_logo_asset_test.dart`); `flutter build apk --debug` succeeds with the new icons.

<details><summary>Architecture</summary>

```mermaid
flowchart TD
  SRC[issue #7 artwork URL] --> F[tool/logo_source/android_robot_960.png]
  F --> GEN[tool/generate_icons.py]
  GEN --> A[assets/images/app_logo.png]
  GEN --> AND[Android mipmap ic_launcher x5]
  GEN --> IOS[iOS AppIcon x15]
  A --> W[AppLogo widget] --> L[LoginPage]
```
</details>

All checks pass. Final summary:

## gh-7 — app logo replaced with the ticket-provided artwork ✅

**Pre-flight resolution:** this leg re-opened as needs-input, but the requester then replied on the issue ([comment 6310410679](https://github.com/ajaxspace/dm_tools_app_example/issues/7#issuecomment-6310410679)) supplying the logo URL — highlight resolved, normal flow resumed with the real artwork (no substitution needed this time).

**Implemented (TDD, RED→GREEN):**
1. **RED** — 2 failing tests first: `LoginPage app logo` widget test (logo asset above the headline, keyed `login_app_logo`) + `app_logo_asset_test.dart` (asset ships in bundle, square 1024).
2. **GREEN** — `AppLogo` widget (`lib/ui/app_logo.dart`), wired into `LoginPage`, asset declared in pubspec.
3. **Artwork** — requester's URL is a 200px thumb; Wikimedia serves only fixed sizes for this file (200 now rejected), so the **same SVG** was fetched at 960px (largest served) and committed at `tool/logo_source/`; `tool/generate_icons.py` centers it on an opaque white badge and emits the 1024px in-app master, all 5 Android `mipmap` sizes and all 15 iOS `AppIcon` sizes. Robot artwork/colors untouched; app name, colors, layout otherwise unchanged.

**Verification:** `flutter pub get` exit 0 · `flutter analyze` no issues · `flutter test` **37/37 pass** · `flutter build apk --debug` succeeded, and the APK's launcher icons are **pixel-identical** to the new set with the in-app asset bundled byte-exact.
